- [ ] **Step 6: Implement bounded, checked journal filesystem I/O**

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/journal-filesystem.ts`:

```ts
import { constants } from "node:fs";
import { lstat, mkdir, open, readdir, realpath, rename, unlink } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
export interface JournalFilesystem {
  initialize(): Promise<void>;
  inventory(): Promise<Array<{ name: string; bytes: number }>>;
  read(name: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null>;
  write(name: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<void>;
  sync(name: string): Promise<void>;
  replace(from: string, to: string): Promise<void>;
  syncDirectory(): Promise<void>;
  remove(name: string): Promise<void>;
}
export async function writeAll(bytes: Uint8Array, write: (bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number) => Promise<number>): Promise<void> {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length;) {
    const count = await write(bytes, offset);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count <= 0 || count > bytes.length - offset) throw new Error("journal short write");
    offset += count;
  }
}
export function createJournalFilesystem(userData: string): JournalFilesystem {
  const root = path.resolve(userData, "device-broker");
  let initialized = false;
  const safe = (name: string): string => {
    if (!/^(faults(?:\.previous)?\.json|faults\.(?:next|backup)-[0-9a-f-]{36}\.json)$/.test(name)) throw new Error("journal filename");
    return path.join(root, name);
  };
  const directory = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const info = await lstat(root);
    if (!info.isDirectory() || info.isSymbolicLink() || await realpath(root) !== root) throw new Error("journal directory");
  };
  const regular = async (name: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    await directory();
    try {
      const info = await lstat(safe(name));
      if (!info.isFile() || info.isSymbolicLink() || info.nlink !== 1 || info.size > 8388608) throw new Error("journal unsafe file");
      return true;
    } catch (error) { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false; throw error; }
  };
  const syncDirectory = async (target = root): Promise<void> => {
    const fd = await open(target, constants.O_RDONLY);
    try { await fd.sync(); } finally { await fd.close(); }
  };
  return {
    async initialize() {
      await mkdir(root, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }); await directory();
      // This is a capability probe, not a silent file-sync-only downgrade.
      await syncDirectory(); await syncDirectory(path.dirname(root)); initialized = true;
    },
    async inventory() {
      if (!initialized) throw new Error("journal not initialized"); await directory();
      const names = await readdir(root);
      if (names.length > 256) throw new Error("journal directory entry budget");
      const result: Array<{ name: string; bytes: number }> = [];
      for (const name of names) {
        const info = await lstat(path.join(root, name));
        if (!info.isFile() || info.isSymbolicLink() || info.nlink !== 1) throw new Error("journal unsafe evidence");
        result.push({ name, bytes: info.size });
      }
      return result;
    },
    async read(name) {
      if (!await regular(name)) return null;
      const fd = await open(safe(name), constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
      try {
        const info = await fd.stat(); if (!info.isFile() || info.nlink !== 1 || info.size > 8388608) throw new Error("journal read budget");
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(info.size); let offset = 0;
        while (offset < bytes.length) {
          const { bytesRead } = await fd.read(bytes, offset, bytes.length - offset, offset);
          if (!bytesRead) throw new Error("journal truncated read"); offset += bytesRead;
        }
        if ((await fd.stat()).size !== bytes.length) throw new Error("journal changed during read");
        return bytes;
      } finally { await fd.close(); }
    },
    async write(name, bytes) {
      await directory(); if (bytes.length > 8388608) throw new Error("journal write budget");
      const fd = await open(safe(name), constants.O_CREAT | constants.O_EXCL | constants.O_WRONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
      try { await writeAll(bytes, async (data, offset) => (await fd.write(data, offset, data.length - offset, offset)).bytesWritten); }
      finally { await fd.close(); }
    },
    async sync(name) {
      if (!await regular(name)) throw new Error("journal temp absent");
      const fd = await open(safe(name), constants.O_RDWR | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
      try { await fd.sync(); } finally { await fd.close(); }
    },
    async replace(from, to) { if (!await regular(from)) throw new Error("journal temp absent"); await regular(to); await rename(safe(from), safe(to)); },
    syncDirectory: () => syncDirectory(),
    async remove(name) { if (await regular(name)) await unlink(safe(name)); },
  };
}
```

No directory-sync error is swallowed. Platforms that cannot supply this barrier remain journal-unwritable; controller runs platform adapter conformance outside sandbox. This does not certify power-loss durability or Windows replacement merely because the Node test passed.

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/journal.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { z } from "zod";
import { namespacedIdSchema } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import { sourceKeySchema } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { FaultJournalDocument, SafetyFaultEntry, ProfileWriterLock } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { JournalPort, DeviceRecoverySnapshot } from "./journal-port.js";
import type { JournalFilesystem } from "./journal-filesystem.js";
const handle = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
const counter = z.number().int().min(0).max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
const digest = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
const resourceOwner = z.strictObject({ sourceKey: sourceKeySchema, pluginId: namespacedIdSchema, generation: counter, hostEpoch: handle, processEpoch: handle });
const owner = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("plugin"), owner: resourceOwner }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("core"), adapter: z.enum(["deployment", "program", "remote-files", "monitor", "battery", "motor", "lab", "recovery"]), hostEpoch: handle, workbenchInstance: handle }),
]);
const reasons = ["provider-disabled", "disconnected", "quarantined", "ui-scope-unavailable", "unsupported-capability", "foreground", "recording", "connecting", "source-changing", "unbound", "joining", "unsynced", "not-holder", "viewer", "authority-changed", "scope-expired", "preflight-program-running", "preflight-output-unknown", "preflight-output-moving", "motor-unavailable", "source-changed", "mode-unavailable", "provider-failure", "provider-contract", "journal-unwritable", "journal-corrupt", "identity-ambiguous", "readback-failed", "stop-deadline", "connection-lost", "provider-stalled", "deadline", "cancelled", "disabled", "safe-mode", "shutting-down", "process-lost", "protocol", "provider-conflict", "none", "host-restarted"] as const;
const fault = z.strictObject({
  id: handle, revision: counter, owner, providerId: namespacedIdSchema, providerGeneration: counter,
  physical: z.strictObject({ providerId: namespacedIdSchema, family: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9:._-]{0,63}$/), basis: z.enum(["serial", "endpoint", "unknown"]), digest: digest.nullable(), strength: z.enum(["stable", "session-only"]) }),
  sessionId: handle, operationId: handle, operationClass: z.enum(["finite-motion", "program-launch", "safety-stop"]),
  createdAt: counter, updatedAt: counter, state: z.enum(["pending", "active-program", "unconfirmed", "resolved"]),
  dispatch: z.enum(["not-sent", "sent", "unknown"]), movement: z.enum(["not-started", "completed", "interrupted", "timed-out", "unknown"]),
  stopRequested: z.boolean(), stopConfirmation: z.enum(["not-required", "pending", "confirmed", "unconfirmed"]), cause: z.enum(reasons),
  resolution: z.strictObject({ kind: z.enum(["not-issued", "confirmed-on-original-session", "observed-idle"]), at: counter, sessionId: handle, identityEvidence: z.enum(["same-session", "serial-match", "user-confirmed-device"]) }).nullable(),
});
const documentSchema = z.strictObject({ schemaVersion: z.literal(1), revision: counter, entries: z.array(fault).max(64), integrity: z.strictObject({ algorithm: z.literal("sha256"), digest }) });
export function canonical(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    return `{${Object.keys(record).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(record[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  }
  throw new Error("journal non-JSON value");
}
function checksum(document: Pick<FaultJournalDocument, "schemaVersion" | "revision" | "entries">): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(canonical(document), "utf8").digest("hex");
}
export function journalDocument(revision: number, entries: SafetyFaultEntry[]): FaultJournalDocument {
  const body = { schemaVersion: 1 as const, revision, entries };
  const result = { ...body, integrity: { algorithm: "sha256" as const, digest: checksum(body) } };
  return parseJournal(Buffer.from(canonical(result)));
}
export function parseJournal(bytes: Uint8Array): FaultJournalDocument {
  if (bytes.length > 8388608) throw new Error("journal byte limit");
  const parsed = documentSchema.parse(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes)));
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of parsed.entries) {
    if (ids.has(item.id) || Buffer.byteLength(canonical(item)) > 8192) throw new Error("journal entry limit"); ids.add(item.id);
    if (item.physical.providerId !== item.providerId || item.updatedAt < item.createdAt) throw new Error("journal identity");
    if ((item.physical.basis === "unknown") !== (item.physical.digest === null)) throw new Error("journal digest basis");
    if (item.physical.strength === "stable" && item.physical.basis !== "serial") throw new Error("journal weak identity");
    if ((item.state === "resolved") !== (item.resolution !== null)) throw new Error("journal resolution");
  }
  if (checksum({ schemaVersion: 1, revision: parsed.revision, entries: parsed.entries }) !== parsed.integrity.digest) throw new Error("journal integrity");
  return parsed;
}
export function createJournal(fs: JournalFilesystem, profile: ProfileWriterLock): JournalPort {
  profile.assertHeld();
  let committed = journalDocument(0, []), loaded = false, blocked = false;
  let health: DeviceRecoverySnapshot["journalHealth"] = "ready";
  let restart = false, pending = 0, tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  const listeners = new Set<(snapshot: DeviceRecoverySnapshot) => void>();
  const snapshot = (): DeviceRecoverySnapshot => {
    const faults = committed.entries.map((original) => { const item = structuredClone(original); return restart && item.state !== "resolved"
      ? { ...item, state: "unconfirmed" as const, movement: "unknown" as const, stopConfirmation: "unconfirmed" as const, cause: "host-restarted" as const }
      : item; });
    return { revision: committed.revision, journalHealth: health === "ready" && faults.length === 64 && faults.every((item) => item.state !== "resolved") ? "full" : health,
      faults, blockers: faults.filter((item) => item.state !== "resolved").map((item) => item.id) };
  };
  const emit = (): void => { for (const listener of listeners) { try { listener(snapshot()); } catch { /* Subscriber failure cannot clear evidence. */ } } };
  return {
    async load() {
      profile.assertHeld(); if (loaded) return structuredClone(committed);
      const found: FaultJournalDocument[] = [];
      try {
        try { await fs.initialize(); } catch { health = "unwritable"; throw new Error("journal initialization"); }
        const files = await fs.inventory();
        if (files.reduce((n, file) => n + file.bytes, 0) > 8388608) throw new Error("journal physical budget");
        let current: FaultJournalDocument | undefined;
        for (const file of files) {
          if (!/^faults(?:\.previous|\.(?:next|backup)-[0-9a-f-]{36})?\.json$/.test(file.name)) { health = "corrupt"; continue; }
          try {
            const bytes = await fs.read(file.name); if (!bytes) throw new Error("journal missing file");
            const doc = parseJournal(bytes); found.push(doc);
            if (file.name === "faults.json") current = doc;
          } catch { health = "corrupt"; }
        }
        if (files.length && !current) health = "corrupt";
        if (current) committed = current;
        const newer = found.filter((doc) => doc.revision > committed.revision);
        if (newer.length || health === "corrupt") {
          health = "corrupt";
          const evidence = new Map<string, SafetyFaultEntry>(committed.entries.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
          for (const doc of found) for (const item of doc.entries) {
            const old = evidence.get(item.id);
            if (item.state !== "resolved" && (!old || old.state === "resolved" || item.revision > old.revision)) evidence.set(item.id, item);
          }
          if (evidence.size > 64) throw new Error("journal evidence exceeds display bound");
          committed = journalDocument(Math.max(committed.revision, ...found.map((doc) => doc.revision)), [...evidence.values()]);
        }
      } catch { if (health !== "unwritable") health = "corrupt"; }
      loaded = true; restart = true; blocked = health !== "ready"; emit(); return structuredClone(committed);
    },
    commit(input) {
      profile.assertHeld();
      if (!loaded || blocked || pending >= 64) return Promise.reject(new Error("journal write blocked"));
      const next = parseJournal(Buffer.from(canonical(input))); pending++;
      let expired = false;
      const task = tail.then(async () => {
        profile.assertHeld(); if (blocked || expired) throw new Error("journal write blocked");
        if (next.revision !== committed.revision + 1) throw new Error("journal stale revision");
        for (const old of committed.entries) {
          const item = next.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === old.id);
          if (old.state !== "resolved" && !item) throw new Error("journal unresolved eviction");
          if (item && (item.revision < old.revision || (item.revision === old.revision && canonical(item) !== canonical(old)))) throw new Error("journal entry revision");
        }
        const bytes = Buffer.from(canonical(next)), previous = Buffer.from(canonical(committed));
        const inventory = await fs.inventory();
        if (inventory.reduce((n, file) => n + file.bytes, 0) + bytes.length + previous.length > 8388608) throw new Error("journal replacement quota");
        const temporary = `faults.next-${randomUUID()}.json`;
        await fs.write(temporary, bytes); await fs.sync(temporary);
        if (committed.revision > 0) {
          const backup = `faults.backup-${randomUUID()}.json`;
          await fs.write(backup, previous); await fs.sync(backup);
          profile.assertHeld(); await fs.replace(backup, "faults.previous.json"); await fs.syncDirectory();
        }
        profile.assertHeld(); if (expired) throw new Error("journal deadline");
        await fs.replace(temporary, "faults.json"); await fs.syncDirectory();
        if (!expired) { committed = next; restart = false; emit(); }
      }).catch((error: unknown) => { blocked = true; health = "unwritable"; emit(); throw error; }).finally(() => { pending--; });
      tail = task.catch(() => {});
      return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => { expired = true; blocked = true; health = "unwritable"; emit(); reject(new Error("journal deadline")); }, 5000);
        task.then(() => { clearTimeout(timer); if (!expired) resolve(); }, (error: unknown) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); });
      });
    },
    snapshot,
    subscribe(listener) { listeners.add(listener); return () => { listeners.delete(listener); }; },
  };
}
```

The integrity hash is a corruption check. It is not authentication. Neither load nor a late commit dispatches equipment work. Final readback remains the broker's physical observation even when the journal commit fails; the broker must report `stopConfirmed: true, journalCommitted: false` and keep normal close blocked.

- [ ] **Step 11: Implement the frozen recovery port and its local broker driver**

Modify (F scaffold; baseline N) `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/recovery-port.ts`: replace the declaration scaffold, preserving exported names and frozen signatures.

```ts
import type { BusinessResult, Counter, DeviceErrorDetail, Handle, PermissionErrorDetail, ResourceErrorDetail } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { CoreActionReference, CoreActionTarget, CoreActionValidationPort, PhysicalIdentity } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { IdleObservation, ProviderOutcome } from "./provider.js";
import type { DeviceRecoverySnapshot, JournalPort } from "./journal-port.js";
import { journalDocument } from "./journal.js";
import type { DeviceFailureDetail, DeviceRecoveryPort } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
export type { DeviceFailureDetail, DeviceRecoveryPort, DeviceRecoverySnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
type Result = BusinessResult<DeviceRecoverySnapshot, DeviceFailureDetail>;
// Local dependency supplied by T2's registry. occupy must reserve the recovery lane
// synchronously before its first await, reject foreground/recording, and retain
// original occupancy through work, journal publication and cleanup settlement.
export interface RecoveryDriver {
  wallNow(): number; // Unix epoch milliseconds, independent of monotonic deadlines.
  describe(sessionId: Handle): { sessionId: Handle; providerGeneration: Counter; physical: PhysicalIdentity } | null;
  occupy<T>(sessionId: Handle, work: (lane: {
    observe(): Promise<ProviderOutcome<IdleObservation>>;
    stop(): Promise<ProviderOutcome<IdleObservation>>;
  }) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
}
const denied = (): Result => ({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_PERMISSION_DENIED", message: "A current core action is required.", detail: { kind: "permission", reason: "user-action-required" } } });
const stale = (): Result => ({ ok: false, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE", message: "Recovery evidence is stale.", detail: { kind: "resource", reason: "stale", resource: "journal" } } });
const failure = (reason: "identity-ambiguous" | "readback-failed" | "journal-unwritable" | "provider-disabled", confirmed = false): Result => ({ ok: false, error: {
  code: reason === "readback-failed" ? "PLUGIN_E_DEVICE_STOP_UNCONFIRMED" : reason === "provider-disabled" ? "PLUGIN_E_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE" : "PLUGIN_E_DEVICE_OPERATION",
  message: "Recovery remains blocked.", detail: { kind: "device", reason, dispatch: "unknown", stopConfirmation: confirmed ? "confirmed" : "unconfirmed" },
} });
export function isIdle(value: IdleObservation | null): value is IdleObservation {
  return value !== null && value.programStopped && value.outputs.length === 4
    && new Set(value.outputs.map((o) => o.actuatorId)).size === 4
    && value.outputs.every((o) => o.known && o.busy === false && o.speed === 0);
}
export function createDeviceRecovery(input: { journal: JournalPort; actions: CoreActionValidationPort; driver: RecoveryDriver }): DeviceRecoveryPort {
  const { journal, actions, driver } = input;
  const run = async (action: CoreActionReference, target: CoreActionTarget, work: () => Promise<Result>): Promise<Result> => {
    if (!actions.claim(action, target)) return denied();
    try { return await work(); } finally { actions.complete(action); }
  };
  const resolve = async (target: Extract<CoreActionTarget, { kind: "device-stop" | "device-reconcile" }>, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<Result> => {
    const fault = journal.snapshot().faults.find((e) => e.id === target.faultId);
    if (!fault || fault.state === "resolved") return stale();
    const session = driver.describe(target.sessionId);
    if (!session) return failure("provider-disabled");
    if (session.physical.providerId !== fault.providerId || session.physical.family !== fault.physical.family) return failure("identity-ambiguous");
    if (target.kind === "device-reconcile" && target.identityEvidence === "serial-match"
      && (session.physical.strength !== "stable" || fault.physical.strength !== "stable"
        || session.physical.basis !== "serial" || fault.physical.basis !== "serial"
        || session.physical.digest === null || session.physical.digest !== fault.physical.digest)) return failure("identity-ambiguous");
    // user-confirmed-device and current-device stop are admitted only because the
    // ledger claim binds this fault/session to actual core confirmation evidence.
    try {
      return await driver.occupy(target.sessionId, async (lane) => {
        if (!actions.isClaimed(action, target)) return denied();
        const outcome = await (target.kind === "device-stop" ? lane.stop() : lane.observe());
        if (!actions.isClaimed(action, target)) return denied();
        const current = driver.describe(target.sessionId);
        if (!current || current.providerGeneration !== session.providerGeneration
          || current.physical.digest !== session.physical.digest) return stale();
        if (outcome.error || !isIdle(outcome.value)) return failure("readback-failed");
        const document = await journal.load();
        if (!actions.isClaimed(action, target)) return denied();
        const existing = document.entries.find((e) => e.id === fault.id);
        if (!existing || existing.revision !== fault.revision) return stale();
        const same = fault.sessionId === target.sessionId && fault.providerGeneration === session.providerGeneration;
        const at = Math.max(driver.wallNow(), fault.updatedAt);
        const entries = document.entries.map((e) => e.id !== fault.id ? e : {
          ...fault, revision: fault.revision + 1, updatedAt: at, state: "resolved" as const,
          stopConfirmation: "confirmed" as const,
          resolution: { kind: same && target.kind === "device-stop" ? "confirmed-on-original-session" as const : "observed-idle" as const,
            at, sessionId: target.sessionId,
            identityEvidence: same ? "same-session" as const : target.kind === "device-reconcile" ? target.identityEvidence : "user-confirmed-device" as const },
        });
        try { await journal.commit(journalDocument(document.revision + 1, entries)); }
        catch { return failure("journal-unwritable", true); }
        return { ok: true, value: journal.snapshot() };
      });
    } catch { return failure("readback-failed"); }
  };
  return {
    snapshot: () => journal.snapshot(), subscribe: (listener) => journal.subscribe(listener),
    stopCurrent(value) { const target = { kind: "device-stop" as const, faultId: value.faultId, sessionId: value.sessionId }; return run(value.action, target, () => resolve(target, value.action)); },
    reconcile(value) { const target = { kind: "device-reconcile" as const, faultId: value.faultId, sessionId: value.sessionId, identityEvidence: value.identityEvidence }; return run(value.action, target, () => resolve(target, value.action)); },
    clearResolved(value) {
      const target = { kind: "device-clear" as const, entryIds: [...value.entryIds] };
      return run(value.action, target, async () => {
        if (!value.entryIds.length || value.entryIds.length > 64 || new Set(value.entryIds).size !== value.entryIds.length) return stale();
        const document = await journal.load();
        if (!actions.isClaimed(value.action, target)) return denied();
        if (value.entryIds.some((id) => !document.entries.some((e) => e.id === id && e.state === "resolved"))) return stale();
        try { await journal.commit(journalDocument(document.revision + 1, document.entries.filter((e) => !value.entryIds.includes(e.id)))); }
        catch { return failure("journal-unwritable"); }
        return { ok: true, value: journal.snapshot() };
      });
    },
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 13: Implement the main-only participant**

Modify (F scaffold; baseline N) `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/resource-participant.ts`: replace the declaration scaffold, preserving exported names and frozen signatures.

```ts
import type { Counter } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DeviceDisposition, DeviceResourceParticipant } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
export interface ResourceDriver {
  revokeOwner: DeviceResourceParticipant["retire"];
  revokeProvider(providerId: string, providerGeneration: Counter): readonly Promise<DeviceDisposition>[];
  revokeAll(): readonly Promise<DeviceDisposition>[];
}
// T2 owns first-end ledgers and the 15s + 5s cleanup clocks. Revocation functions
// must be synchronous; their returned promises already run independently of the
// cancelled ordinary request. This wrapper never renews a grant or deadline.
export function createDeviceResourceParticipant(driver: ResourceDriver): DeviceResourceParticipant {
  const collect = async (work: readonly Promise<DeviceDisposition>[]): Promise<DeviceDisposition> => {
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(work);
    const value: DeviceDisposition = { stopConfirmed: true, journalCommitted: true, faultIds: [] };
    for (const result of results) {
      if (result.status === "rejected") { value.stopConfirmed = false; value.journalCommitted = false; continue; }
      value.stopConfirmed &&= result.value.stopConfirmed;
      value.journalCommitted &&= result.value.journalCommitted;
      value.faultIds.push(...result.value.faultIds);
    }
    value.faultIds = [...new Set(value.faultIds)];
    return value;
  };
  return {
    retire: (owner, reason) => driver.revokeOwner(owner, reason),
    retireProvider: (id, generation) => collect(driver.revokeProvider(id, generation)),
    beginShutdown: () => collect(driver.revokeAll()),
  };
}
```

A-T2 owns the production facade in `broker-port.ts` and injected internal drivers in `broker.ts`; T3 exports the implementations and imports its registry-backed inputs type-only. This is a required construction step, not a journal snapshot substitute. A-T2 supplies `recoveryDriver: RecoveryDriver` and `resourceDriver: ResourceDriver` from its operation/session registry: `describe` looks up the live generation; `occupy` reserves synchronously, calls provider `observeIdle` for observe and `stopAndReadback({kind:"current-device"})` for stop, and awaits the original cleanup settlement before releasing. The revoke functions synchronously fence admission and return the already-started original cleanup promises. They never call the public facade recursively.

The production facade supplies `{recovery:createDeviceRecovery, participant:createDeviceResourceParticipant}` to `createBroker(input, factories)`. The internal core invokes each dependency once with its registry-backed driver; this step adds no duplicate construction.

Return these exact instances as `DeviceBrokerPort.recovery` and `.resources`; construct each once per broker. A-T8 passes this broker participant to the real controller during D150. In `broker-port.test.ts` (A-T3 owner) and read-only `operations.test.ts` (A-T2 owner), load a pending restart journal, explicitly connect, reconcile and assert the provider read trace with no stop/run/upload. Then mint a real device-stop action, hold final journal commit after stop readback and assert foreground admission stays blocked. Reject that commit and assert the retained journal blocker. Retire a live owner/provider and assert admission is revoked before awaiting disposition, with the same original cleanup promise. Repeat through the D150 controller disable/window-loss entrypoints in its owned tests. Run these together with T3's tests at P150:

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement the library binding without a mutable current context**

Replace `packages/device/src/io-boundary.ts`:

```ts
import type { Ev3Connection } from "./contracts.js";
export type DeviceIoStep = "motor" | "file-transfer" | "ordinary";
export interface DeviceIoBoundary {
  beforeExchange(step: DeviceIoStep): void;
  timeoutMs(step: DeviceIoStep): number;
  afterExchange(step: DeviceIoStep): void;
}
export interface DeviceIoBinding {
  readonly step: DeviceIoStep;
  readonly signal: AbortSignal;
  readonly boundary: DeviceIoBoundary;
  exchange<T>(payload: Uint8Array, invoke: (signal: AbortSignal, timeoutMs: number) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
}
export function deviceIoStep(payload: Uint8Array, fallback: DeviceIoStep): DeviceIoStep {
  if (payload[0] === 1 && payload[1] === 0x98) return "ordinary";
  return payload[0] === 1 && [0x92, 0x93, 0x94, 0x95, 0x99, 0x9a].includes(payload[1] ?? -1) ? "file-transfer" : fallback;
}
export function bindDeviceConnection(connection: Ev3Connection, binding: DeviceIoBinding): Ev3Connection {
  const run = async <T>(payload: Uint8Array, requested: number, invoke: (signal: AbortSignal, timeoutMs: number) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
    const step = deviceIoStep(payload, binding.step);
    const closing = payload[0] === 1 && payload[1] === 0x98;
    if (!closing) binding.boundary.beforeExchange(step);
    // Original-operation close has its own broker cleanup deadline. Do not
    // reject it merely because the ordinary work budget has expired.
    const remaining = closing ? 5000 : binding.boundary.timeoutMs(step);
    const limit = Math.min(requested, remaining, step === "motor" ? 2000 : step === "file-transfer" ? 10000 : 5000);
    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) throw new Error("Device exchange deadline.");
    const value = await binding.exchange(payload, (signal, remaining) => invoke(signal, Math.min(limit, remaining)));
    if (!closing) binding.boundary.afterExchange(step);
    return value;
  };
  return {
    ...(connection.onDisconnect ? { onDisconnect: (listener: (error: Error) => void) => connection.onDisconnect!(listener) } : {}),
    exchange: (payload, _signal, timeoutMs = 5000) => run(payload, timeoutMs, (signal, timeout) => connection.exchange(payload, signal, timeout)),
    transmit: (payload, _signal) => run(payload, 5000, (signal) => connection.transmit(payload, signal)),
    close: () => connection.close(),
  };
}
```

The underlying session's `exclusive` is only a reentrancy assertion. The broker retains foreground occupancy while a bound view exists; no view, native descriptor or transport constructor leaves the provider. `binding.exchange` routes file-close to the original cleanup admission even after ordinary authority is revoked (AM-05). A-T2 `operations.ts` binds `exchange("file-close", invoke)` directly to the operation's retained `ProviderCleanupContext.exchange("file-close", invoke)` and delegates `assertContinuation("file-close")` to `assertCleanup("file-close")`. It uses the original handle whitelist, independent signal/deadline and retained occupancy; no ordinary cancellation/authority post-check may suppress the close or discard its evidence. This exception grants no delete, rename or upload rights. `legacy.ts` uses the same bound session and the library close path skips both ordinary boundary checks; providers never create or borrow cleanup rights.

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { DeviceDescriptor, DeviceMonitorSnapshot } from "@kobrixa/device";
import type { PhysicalIdentity } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { Handle, SourceCatalog, TelemetryFrame } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { ProviderCatalogPort } from "../../device-broker/provider.js";
export const EV3_PROVIDER_ID = "kobrixa.device-ev3";
export function physicalIdentity(descriptor: DeviceDescriptor): PhysicalIdentity {
  const serial = descriptor.serialNumber?.trim();
  const basis = serial ? "serial" : descriptor.address || descriptor.metadata?.path ? "endpoint" : "unknown";
  const identity = serial || descriptor.address || descriptor.metadata?.path;
  const hash = createHash("sha256");
  for (const value of [EV3_PROVIDER_ID, "ev3", basis, identity ?? ""]) {
    const bytes = Buffer.from(value, "utf8"), length = Buffer.alloc(4); length.writeUInt32BE(bytes.length); hash.update(length); hash.update(bytes);
  }
  return { providerId: EV3_PROVIDER_ID, family: "ev3", basis, strength: serial ? "stable" : "session-only", digest: basis === "unknown" ? null : hash.digest("hex") };
}
export class Ev3Catalog {
  private signature = "";
  private value: SourceCatalog;
  constructor(private port: ProviderCatalogPort, private sessionId: Handle) { this.value = { sessionId, sourceRevision: 0, channels: [], actuators: [] }; }
  get snapshot(): SourceCatalog { return structuredClone(this.value); }
  accept(reading: DeviceMonitorSnapshot): SourceCatalog {
    if (reading.inputs.length > 4 || reading.outputs.length !== 4 || reading.inputs.some((p) => p.values.length > 8)) throw new Error("provider-contract");
    const channels: SourceCatalog["channels"] = [], actuators: SourceCatalog["actuators"] = [];
    const add = (item: Omit<SourceCatalog["channels"][number], "channelId">) => channels.push({ ...item, channelId: this.port.identify({ sessionId: this.sessionId, portId: item.portId, typeId: item.typeId, modeId: item.modeId, component: item.component, unit: item.unit }) });
    for (const p of reading.inputs) for (let component = 0; component < p.values.length; component++) add({ kind: "input", portId: `input:${p.port}`, typeId: `ev3:${p.type}`, modeId: p.mode >= 0 && p.mode < 8 ? `mode:${p.mode}` : null, component, name: p.name || `Input ${p.port + 1}`, modeName: p.modeName, unit: p.unit, decimals: p.decimals, state: p.state });
    for (const p of reading.outputs) {
      const portId = `output:${p.port}`, typeId = `ev3:${p.type}`;
      add({ kind: "output-angle", portId, typeId, modeId: null, component: 0, name: p.name || `Motor ${p.port}`, modeName: "", unit: "deg", decimals: 0, state: p.state });
      actuators.push({ actuatorId: this.port.identify({ sessionId: this.sessionId, portId, typeId, modeId: null, component: 0, unit: "actuator" }), portId, typeId, name: p.name || `Motor ${p.port}`, state: p.state });
    }
    add({ kind: "battery-percent", portId: null, typeId: "ev3:battery-percent", modeId: null, component: 0, name: "Battery", modeName: "", unit: "%", decimals: 0, state: "ready" });
    add({ kind: "battery-voltage", portId: null, typeId: "ev3:battery-voltage", modeId: null, component: 0, name: "Battery voltage", modeName: "", unit: "V", decimals: 2, state: "ready" });
    const signature = JSON.stringify({ channels, actuators });
    if (signature !== this.signature) { this.signature = signature; this.value = { sessionId: this.sessionId, sourceRevision: this.value.sourceRevision + 1, channels, actuators }; }
    return this.snapshot;
  }
  frame(reading: DeviceMonitorSnapshot): TelemetryFrame {
    const sources = this.accept(reading);
    return { sequence: 0, sampledAt: 0, elapsedMs: 0, sourceRevision: sources.sourceRevision, status: "ok", program: reading.program.status,
      values: sources.channels.map((c) => {
        const port = Number(c.portId?.split(":")[1]);
        const value = c.kind === "input" ? reading.inputs.find((p) => p.port === port)?.values[c.component]
          : c.kind === "output-angle" ? reading.outputs.find((p) => p.port === port)?.angle
          : c.kind === "battery-percent" ? reading.battery.percent : reading.battery.voltage;
        return { channelId: c.channelId, value: typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null };
      }) };
  }
}
```

`{ sequence: 0, sampledAt: 0, elapsedMs: 0 }` is the AM-06 unpublished sentinel for both read frames and mode-change snapshots. A-T2 `sampler.ts` rejects provider-assigned nonzero sequence and replaces all three fields at receipt before any read, snapshot, event or ring publication. Core and plugin consumers share that receipt origin and monotonically increasing sample sequence, including busy/gap evidence; zero is never published.

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/device-providers/ev3/legacy.ts`:

```ts
import { managedPath, type DeviceSession } from "@kobrixa/device";
import type { LegacyProviderRequest, LegacyProviderValue, ProviderStep } from "../../device-broker/provider.js";
export async function executeLegacy(bind: (step: ProviderStep) => DeviceSession, request: LegacyProviderRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<LegacyProviderValue> {
  const path = managedPath(request.remotePath, !["list", "download", "run"].includes(request.kind));
  switch (request.kind) {
    case "list": return { kind: "entries", entries: await bind("read").list(path, signal) };
    case "download": {
      let transferred = 0;
      await bind("read").download(path, async (bytes) => { await request.sink(bytes); transferred += bytes.length; }, signal, request.progress);
      return { kind: "transfer", transferred };
    }
    case "upload": {
      await bind("file-begin").uploadStream(path, request.size, request.chunks, signal, request.progress);
      return { kind: "transfer", transferred: request.size };
    }
    case "mkdir": {
      const session = bind("file-mkdir"); await session.createDirectory(path, signal);
      const parent = path.slice(0, path.lastIndexOf("/"));
      const verified = (await bind("read").list(parent, signal)).some((e) => e.path === path && e.kind === "directory");
      if (!verified) throw new Error("Directory creation was not verified.");
      return { kind: "mutation", verified };
    }
    case "rename": await bind("file-copy").rename(path, managedPath(request.destination, true), signal); return { kind: "mutation", verified: true };
    case "delete": await bind("file-remove").delete(path, signal); return { kind: "mutation", verified: true };
    case "run": await bind("program-run").run(path, signal); return { kind: "launch", sent: true };
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the finite motion engine**

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/device-providers/ev3/motion.ts`:

```ts
import { randomInt } from "node:crypto";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import { REMOTE_PROJECT_ROOT, type DeviceSession, type MotorTestReading } from "@kobrixa/device";
import type { Handle, MotionSpec } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { IdleObservation, MotionCompletion, ProviderCleanupContext, ProviderOperationContext, ProviderStep } from "../../device-broker/provider.js";
import { createMotorTestImage } from "../../device/motor-test-image.js";
type State = { port: number; token: number; helper: boolean; issued: boolean; path: string; origin: number | null; angle: number | null; ctx: ProviderOperationContext; bind: (step: ProviderStep) => DeviceSession };
const knownIdle = (r: MotorTestReading) => r.programStopped && r.outputs.length === 4
  && new Set(r.outputs.map((o) => o.port)).size === 4
  && r.outputs.every((o) => [7, 8, 126].includes(o.type) && o.busy === false && o.speed === 0);
export class Ev3MotionEngine {
  private states = new Map<Handle, State>();
  release(operationId: Handle): void { this.states.delete(operationId); }
  async execute(port: number, motion: MotionSpec, ctx: ProviderOperationContext, bind: (step: ProviderStep) => DeviceSession): Promise<MotionCompletion> {
    if (this.states.has(ctx.operationId) || this.states.size >= 256) throw new Error("provider-contract");
    const s: State = { port, token: randomInt(1, 0x7fffffff), helper: false, issued: false, path: `${REMOTE_PROJECT_ROOT}/kobrixa-motor-${ctx.operationId}.rbf`, origin: null, angle: null, ctx, bind };
    this.states.set(ctx.operationId, s);
    const check = (step: ProviderStep) => { if (ctx.stopState().requested || ctx.now() >= ctx.deadlineMonotonicMs) throw new Error("cancelled"); ctx.assertContinuation(step); };
    const accept = (r: MotorTestReading) => {
      const o = r.outputs.find((value) => value.port === port);
      s.angle = o && [7, 8].includes(o.type) ? o.angle : null;
      if (s.origin === null) s.origin = s.angle;
    };
    const preflight = async () => {
      check("preflight"); const r = await bind("preflight").readMotorTest(ctx.cancellation); check("preflight");
      if (!r.programStopped) throw new Error("preflight-program-running");
      if (r.outputs.some((o) => o.busy === true || (o.speed !== null && o.speed !== 0))) throw new Error("preflight-output-moving");
      if (!knownIdle(r)) throw new Error("preflight-output-unknown");
      const o = r.outputs.find((value) => value.port === port);
      if (!o || ![7, 8].includes(o.type) || o.angle === null) throw new Error("motor-unavailable");
      accept(r);
    };
    const complete = (movement: MotionCompletion["movement"]): MotionCompletion => ({ movement, angle: s.angle, displacement: s.angle === null || s.origin === null ? null : s.angle - s.origin });
    await preflight();
    if (motion.mode === "relative-angle") {
      check("helper-upload");
      await bind("helper-upload").upload(s.path, createMotorTestImage({ token: s.token, port, power: motion.power * motion.direction, angle: motion.degrees, brake: motion.brake }), ctx.cancellation);
      check("helper-upload"); await preflight(); check("helper-run"); s.helper = true;
      await bind("helper-run").runMotorHelper(s.path, ctx.cancellation); check("helper-run");
      const waiting = ctx.now();
      for (;;) {
        check("read"); const reply = await bind("read").readMotorHelper(s.token, ctx.cancellation); check("helper-arm");
        if (ctx.now() - waiting >= 2000) throw new Error("deadline");
        if (reply.owned && reply.state === 0) break;
        await delay(50); check("read");
      }
      check("helper-arm"); s.issued = true; const armed = ctx.now();
      await bind("helper-arm").armMotorHelper(s.token, ctx.cancellation); check("read");
      for (;;) {
        check("read"); const reply = await bind("read").readMotorHelper(s.token, ctx.cancellation); check("read");
        if (!reply.owned) throw new Error("readback-failed");
        s.angle = reply.angle;
        ctx.publishProgress({ stage: "moving", elapsedMs: Math.max(0, ctx.now() - armed), angle: s.angle, displacement: complete("unknown").displacement });
        if (reply.state === 2) {
          if (reply.result === 1) return complete("completed");
          if (reply.result === 2) { ctx.requestSafetyStop("deadline"); return complete("timed-out"); }
          throw new Error("readback-failed");
        }
        if (ctx.now() - armed >= 12000) { ctx.requestSafetyStop("deadline"); return complete("unknown"); }
        await delay(150); check("read");
      }
    }
    check("motion-pulse"); let lastPulse = ctx.now(); const started = lastPulse;
    s.issued = true;
    await bind("motion-pulse").motorTimed(port, motion.power * motion.direction, motion.mode === "jog" ? 400 : motion.durationMs, motion.brake, ctx.cancellation);
    check("read"); const observedStart = ctx.now();
    for (;;) {
      if (ctx.stopState().requested) return complete("interrupted");
      check("read");
      if (motion.mode === "jog" && ctx.now() - started >= 10000) { ctx.requestSafetyStop("deadline"); return complete("timed-out"); }
      await delay(150); check("read");
      const r = await bind("read").readMotorTest(ctx.cancellation); check("read"); accept(r);
      if (!r.programStopped) throw new Error("readback-failed");
      ctx.publishProgress({ stage: "moving", elapsedMs: Math.max(0, ctx.now() - started), angle: s.angle, displacement: complete("unknown").displacement });
      if (motion.mode === "timed") {
        if (ctx.now() - observedStart >= motion.durationMs) return complete("completed");
      } else {
        const remaining = 10000 - (ctx.now() - started);
        if (ctx.now() - lastPulse >= 400 || remaining < 100) { ctx.requestSafetyStop("deadline"); return complete("timed-out"); }
        check("motion-pulse"); lastPulse = ctx.now();
        await bind("motion-pulse").motorTimed(port, motion.power * motion.direction, Math.min(400, Math.floor(remaining)), motion.brake, ctx.cancellation);
        check("read");
      }
    }
  }
  async stop(target: { kind: "operation"; operationId: Handle } | { kind: "current-device" }, ctx: ProviderCleanupContext, bind: (step: "stop" | "readback") => DeviceSession, actuator: (port: number) => Handle): Promise<IdleObservation> {
    const state = target.kind === "operation" ? this.states.get(target.operationId) : undefined;
    let appliedBrake: boolean | undefined;
    const apply = async () => {
      ctx.assertCleanup("stop"); const brake = ctx.brakeRequired();
      if (target.kind === "current-device") {
        await bind("stop").stop(undefined, ctx.signal);
        for (let port = 0; port < 4; port++) { ctx.assertCleanup("stop"); await bind("stop").motorStop(port, brake, ctx.signal); }
      } else if (state) {
        if (state.helper) {
          const owned = await bind("stop").stopMotorHelper(state.token, state.port, brake, ctx.signal);
          ctx.assertCleanup("readback");
          if (!owned) {
            const reading = await bind("readback").readMotorTest(ctx.signal);
            if (!reading.programStopped) throw new Error("readback-failed");
            await bind("stop").motorStop(state.port, brake, ctx.signal);
          }
        } else if (state.issued) await bind("stop").motorStop(state.port, brake, ctx.signal);
      } else throw new Error("readback-failed");
      appliedBrake = brake;
    };
    let last: MotorTestReading | undefined;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
      if (ctx.now() >= ctx.deadlineMonotonicMs) throw new Error("stop-deadline");
      if (appliedBrake === undefined || (!appliedBrake && ctx.brakeRequired())) await apply();
      ctx.assertCleanup("readback"); last = await bind("readback").readMotorTest(ctx.signal); ctx.assertCleanup("readback");
      if (knownIdle(last) && (appliedBrake || !ctx.brakeRequired())) break;
      if (attempt < 4) await delay(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ctx.deadlineMonotonicMs - ctx.now())));
    }
    if (!last) throw new Error("readback-failed");
    const result: IdleObservation = { programStopped: last.programStopped, observedAt: last.sampledAt, outputs: last.outputs.map((o) => ({ actuatorId: actuator(o.port), known: [7, 8, 126].includes(o.type) && o.speed !== null, busy: o.busy, speed: o.speed })) };
    // Deletion is ordinary work: the old work context must still permit it.
    // It is never sent through ProviderCleanupContext, and cannot change evidence.
    if (state?.helper && knownIdle(last)) {
      try { state.ctx.assertContinuation("file-remove"); await state.bind("file-remove").delete(state.path, state.ctx.cancellation); } catch { /* Exact helper path is retained; movement evidence remains unchanged. */ }
    }
    return result;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Ev3Catalog, EV3_PROVIDER_ID, physicalIdentity } from "./catalog.js";
import { executeLegacy } from "./legacy.js";
import { Ev3MotionEngine } from "./motion.js";
import type { IdleObservation } from "../../device-broker/provider.js";
function isIdle(value: IdleObservation): boolean {

}
const capabilities: CapabilityId[] = ["connection.v1", "telemetry.v1", "inputModes.v1", "finiteMotion.v1", "recordingReservation.v1"];
interface Transport { discover(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DeviceDescriptor[]>; connect(target: DeviceDescriptor, signal: AbortSignal, options?: { connectTimeoutMs: number; handshakeTimeoutMs: number }): Promise<EV3DeviceSession>; }
interface RecordState { raw: EV3DeviceSession; connection: ProviderConnection; catalog?: Ev3Catalog; sessionId?: Handle; origin: number; motion: Ev3MotionEngine; removeListener: () => void; }
function descriptor(value: DeviceDescriptor): ProviderConnection["descriptor"] {
  const name = value.name.trim();
  if (!name || [...name].length > 200 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(name)) throw new Error("provider-contract");
  if (value.transport === "mock") throw new Error("provider-contract");
  return { providerId: EV3_PROVIDER_ID, name, transport: value.transport,
    ...(value.address ? { address: value.address } : {}), identity: value.serialNumber?.trim() ? "stable" : "session-only" };
}
function wireStep(payload: Uint8Array, fallback: ProviderStep): ProviderStep {
  if (payload[0] === 1) {
    switch (payload[1]) {
      case 0x98: return "file-close";
      case 0x92: return fallback === "helper-upload" ? "helper-upload" : "file-begin";
      case 0x93: return fallback === "helper-upload" ? "helper-upload" : "file-chunk";
      case 0x94: case 0x95: case 0x99: case 0x9a: return "read";
      case 0x9b: return "file-mkdir";
    }
  }

  if (payload[3] === 0xc0 && payload[4] === 30) return "file-remove";

}

export function buildEv3Provider(ids: ProviderCatalogPort, transports: { usb: Transport; wifi: Transport }): BuiltinDeviceProvider {

    const record = records.get(key); if (!record || !record.raw.connected) throw new Error("disconnected");
    if (ctx?.sessionId) {
      if (record.sessionId && record.sessionId !== ctx.sessionId) throw new Error("provider-contract");
      if (!record.sessionId) { record.sessionId = ctx.sessionId; record.catalog = new Ev3Catalog(ids, ctx.sessionId); }
    }
    return record;
  };
  const reason = (error: unknown): DeviceErrorReason => {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "";
    const valid = ["authority-changed", "cancelled", "deadline", "disconnected", "provider-contract", "preflight-program-running", "preflight-output-unknown", "preflight-output-moving", "motor-unavailable", "source-changed", "mode-unavailable", "readback-failed", "stop-deadline"] as const;
    return valid.find((value) => value === message) ?? "provider-failure";

        const step: DeviceIoStep = fallback === "helper-upload" || fallback === "file-begin" ? "file-transfer" : motor ? "motor" : "ordinary";
        const signal = new AbortController().signal;

          boundary: {
            beforeExchange() { if (late) throw late; ctx.assertContinuation(fallback); },
            timeoutMs: (kind) => Math.min(kind === "motor" ? 2000 : kind === "file-transfer" ? 10000 : 5000, ctx.deadlineMonotonicMs - ctx.now()),
            afterExchange() { try { ctx.assertContinuation(fallback); } catch (error) { late = error; } },
          },
          async exchange(payload, invoke) {
            const actual = wireStep(payload, fallback);
            if (actual !== "file-close" && late) throw late;
            if (actual !== "file-close") ctx.assertContinuation(actual);

            // Its assertion, signal, handle whitelist and deadline are independent.
            if (actual === "file-close") ctx.assertContinuation("file-close");
            const result = await ctx.exchange(actual, async (transportSignal, timeout) => {
              if (dispatch !== "unknown") dispatch = "sent";
              try { return await invoke(transportSignal, timeout); }
              catch (error) { dispatch = "unknown"; if (actual === "file-close") closeFailure = error; throw error; }
            }).catch((error: unknown) => { if (actual === "file-close") closeFailure = error; throw error; });
            // Preserve the reply long enough for session.ts to register its file
            // handle. A failed post-check blocks the very next ordinary exchange
            // and final publication, while original file-close can still run.

    } catch (error) { return { value: null, dispatch, stopConfirmation: "not-required", error: { reason: reason(closeFailure ?? late ?? error), message: closeFailure ? "Original file close failed; cleanup remains unconfirmed." : dispatch === "not-sent" ? "EV3 operation did not start." : "EV3 operation did not complete; partial device changes may remain." } }; }
  };

    step: "motor", signal: ctx.signal,
    boundary: { beforeExchange() { ctx.assertCleanup(step); }, afterExchange() { ctx.assertCleanup(step); }, timeoutMs: () => Math.min(2000, ctx.deadlineMonotonicMs - ctx.now()) },

      const source = catalog.channels.find((c) => c.kind === "input" && c.portId === request.portId); if (!source) throw new Error("source-changed");
      const before = await bind("preflight").readMonitor(ctx.cancellation); ctx.assertContinuation("mode-write");
      if (!before || before.program.status !== "stopped") throw new Error("preflight-program-running");
      const current = record.catalog!.accept(before); if (current.sourceRevision !== catalog.sourceRevision) throw new Error("source-changed");

          if (!id) throw new Error("provider-contract"); return id;
        });
        return { value, dispatch: "sent", stopConfirmation: isIdle(value) ? "confirmed" : "unconfirmed", error: isIdle(value) ? null : { reason: "readback-failed", message: "All outputs were not observed idle." } };

    releaseOperation(id) { for (const record of records.values()) record.motion.release(id); },
```

```ts
it.each(["before-chunk", "after-chunk", "close-fails"])("AM-05 cleanup remains independent: %s", async (point) => {
  const descriptor = { id: "usb:cleanup", name: "Brick", transport: "usb" as const, serialNumber: "cleanup" };
  const commands: number[] = [];
  const cancellation = new AbortController();
  const cleanup = new AbortController();
  let revoked = false;
  const raw = new EV3DeviceSession(descriptor, {
    async exchange(payload, signal) {
      commands.push(payload[1]!);
      if (payload[1] === 0x92) {
        if (point === "before-chunk") { revoked = true; cancellation.abort(); }
        return Uint8Array.of(3, 0x92, 0, 7);
      }
      if (payload[1] === 0x93) { revoked = true; cancellation.abort(); return Uint8Array.of(3, 0x93, 0, 7); }
      expect(payload[1]).toBe(0x98); expect(payload[2]).toBe(7);
      expect(signal).toBe(cleanup.signal); expect(signal.aborted).toBe(false);
      if (point === "close-fails") throw new Error("readback-failed");
      return Uint8Array.of(3, 0x98, 0);
    }, transmit: async () => {}, close: async () => {},

  work.exchange = async (step, invoke) => {
    work.assertContinuation(step);
    return invoke(step === "file-close" ? cleanup.signal : new AbortController().signal, 5000);
  };
```

**Interfaces**

Consumes `DeviceBrokerPort.request<M extends DeviceMethod>(principal: Principal, method: M, params: DeviceParams<M>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DeviceResult<M>>`, `DeviceBrokerPort.legacy(principal: Principal, sessionId: Handle, request: LegacyProviderRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ProviderOutcome<LegacyProviderValue>>`, and `LegacyOperationPort.begin(input: { principal: Principal; sessionId: Handle; operationClass: "file-read" | "file-write" | "deployment" | "program-launch"; signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<LegacyOperation>`. The retained operation remains exactly `{ readonly operationId: Handle; execute(request: LegacyProviderRequest): Promise<ProviderOutcome<LegacyProviderValue>>; renewConfirmation(): void; finish(): Promise<void>; cancel(): Promise<void> }`.

Produces host-only `LegacyFiles.run<T>(sessionId: Handle, work: (session: LegacyFileSession, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>, operationClass?: "file-read" | "file-write" | "deployment" | "program-launch"): Promise<T>`, `createLegacyDevice(deps: LegacyDeviceDependencies): LegacyDevice`, `createLegacyMonitorFeed(broker: DeviceBrokerPort): LegacyMonitorFeed`, the exported `LegacyDevice`/`LegacyFiles` classes, `renewFilePlan(ref: FileBatchRef, owner: CorePrincipal): void` and `LegacyLab`. `LegacyFileSession` is a restricted file-method projection with no transport, helper or motor methods; it only translates to the frozen request union. `DeviceService` keeps its renderer-facing method names. Constructor composition, trusted sender/action minting, battery demand and renew IPC go to T8/V150 without touching H-D/H-V here.

F is the start prerequisite. Runtime acceptance requires T2/T4/T6/T8 and V150. Cover F05/F07/F11/F12/F14/F15/F17/F19/F21 and A-RF3. Preserve the existing Lab store, checkpoints, CSV, calibration and close/update failure guard; this is a device dependency migration, not a 3D recorder migration.

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement file projection and local confirmation lifetime**

Modify (F scaffold; baseline N) `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/legacy-files.ts`: replace the declaration scaffold, preserving exported names and frozen signatures.

```ts
import type { DeviceSession } from "@kobrixa/device";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { Handle } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { LegacyOperationPort } from "./broker-port.js";
import type { LegacyProviderRequest } from "./provider.js";
export interface LegacyFileSession extends Pick<DeviceSession, "list" | "download" | "upload" | "uploadStream" | "createDirectory" | "rename" | "delete" | "run"> {
  confirm<T>(dialog: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
  renewConfirmation(): void;
  remaining(): { idleRemainingMs: number; totalRemainingMs: number };
  cancel(): Promise<void>;
}
export class LegacyFiles {
  constructor(private operations: LegacyOperationPort, private principal: (operationClass: "file-read" | "file-write" | "deployment" | "program-launch") => Principal, private now = () => performance.now()) {}
  async run<T>(sessionId: Handle, work: (session: LegacyFileSession, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>, operationClass: "file-read" | "file-write" | "deployment" | "program-launch" = "file-write"): Promise<T> {
    const created = this.now(), hardDeadline = created + 600000;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const operation = await this.operations.begin({ principal: this.principal(operationClass), sessionId, operationClass, signal: controller.signal });
    let idleDeadline: number | null = null, ended = false, cancelled: Promise<void> | undefined;
    let rejectExpiry!: (error: Error) => void;
    const expiry = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => { rejectExpiry = reject; });
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const cancel = (): Promise<void> => {
      if (!cancelled) { ended = true; controller.abort(new Error("File operation ended; partial device changes may remain.")); cancelled = operation.cancel(); }
      return cancelled!;
    };
    const assert = () => {
      if (ended || controller.signal.aborted || this.now() >= hardDeadline || (idleDeadline !== null && this.now() >= idleDeadline)) throw new Error("File operation expired; partial device changes may remain.");
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      const deadline = Math.min(hardDeadline, idleDeadline ?? hardDeadline);
      timer = setTimeout(() => { const error = new Error("File operation expired; partial device changes may remain."); void cancel().catch(() => {}); rejectExpiry(error); }, Math.max(0, deadline - this.now()));
    };
    const execute = async (request: LegacyProviderRequest) => {
      assert(); const result = await operation.execute(request); assert();
      if (result.error || !result.value) throw new Error(result.error?.message ?? "Device operation outcome is unknown.");
      return result.value;
    };
    const session: LegacyFileSession = {
      async list(remotePath, signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); const value = await execute({ kind: "list", remotePath }); if (value.kind !== "entries") throw new Error("provider-contract"); return value.entries; },
      async download(remotePath, sink, signal, progress = () => {}) { signal.throwIfAborted(); await execute({ kind: "download", remotePath, sink: async (bytes) => { assert(); await sink(bytes); assert(); }, progress }); },
      async upload(remotePath, data, signal) { return session.uploadStream(remotePath, data.length, (async function* () { yield data; })(), signal); },
      async uploadStream(remotePath, size, chunks, signal, progress = () => {}) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        const guarded = async function* () { for await (const bytes of chunks) { assert(); yield bytes; assert(); } };
        await execute({ kind: "upload", remotePath, size, chunks: guarded(), progress });
      },
      async createDirectory(remotePath, signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); await execute({ kind: "mkdir", remotePath }); },
      async rename(remotePath, destination, signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); await execute({ kind: "rename", remotePath, destination }); },
      async delete(remotePath, signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); await execute({ kind: "delete", remotePath }); },
      async run(remotePath, signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); await execute({ kind: "run", remotePath }); },
      async confirm(dialog) {
        assert(); idleDeadline = Math.min(thisNow() + 120000, hardDeadline); operation.renewConfirmation(); schedule();
        try { const value = await Promise.race([dialog(), expiry]); assert(); return value; }
        finally { idleDeadline = null; if (!ended) schedule(); }
      },
      renewConfirmation() { assert(); if (idleDeadline === null) throw new Error("File plan is not awaiting confirmation."); operation.renewConfirmation(); idleDeadline = Math.min(thisNow() + 120000, hardDeadline); schedule(); },
      remaining: () => ({ idleRemainingMs: Math.max(0, Math.ceil((idleDeadline ?? hardDeadline) - this.now())), totalRemainingMs: Math.max(0, Math.ceil(hardDeadline - this.now())) }),
      cancel,
    };
    const thisNow = () => this.now();
    schedule();
    try { return await Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(() => work(session, controller.signal)), expiry]); }
    catch (error) { await cancel(); throw error; }
    finally { ended = true; clearTimeout(timer); await operation.finish(); }
  }
}
```

The `Promise.race` only releases waiting for a native dialog. `operation.cancel()`/`finish()` still belong to T2, which retains any dispatched exchange occupancy through its original cleanup deadline. The late dialog closure sees the aborted signal or `assert()` before any subsequent broker mutation. No new queue or device lock is introduced.

```ts
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
```

```ts
export interface LegacyMonitorFeed {

  broker: DeviceBrokerPort;

export function createLegacyDevice(deps: LegacyDeviceDependencies): LegacyDevice {

export function createLegacyMonitorFeed(broker: DeviceBrokerPort): LegacyMonitorFeed {
  // Shared budget for all demands belonging to the same core identity.
  const bytesByOwner = new Map<string, number>();
  return { async subscribe(input) {
    const principal = structuredClone(input.principal);
    if (principal.kind !== "core") throw new Error("Core telemetry requires a core principal.");
    const ownerKey = JSON.stringify([principal.hostEpoch, principal.workbenchInstance, principal.adapter]);
    const catalog = await broker.request(principal, "devices/session", { sessionId: input.sessionId }, new AbortController().signal);
    if (!catalog.ok) throw new Error(catalog.error.message);
    type Queued = { sequence: Counter; snapshot: ReadSnapshot; sources: SourceCatalog; bytes: number };
    const queue: Queued[] = [];
    let subscription: CoreTelemetrySubscription | undefined, closed = false, scheduled = false, last = 0;
    let disposal: Promise<void> | undefined;
    const release = (bytes: number) => {
      const next = (bytesByOwner.get(ownerKey) ?? 0) - bytes;
      if (next > 0) bytesByOwner.set(ownerKey, next); else bytesByOwner.delete(ownerKey);
    };
    const dispose = (): Promise<void> => {
      closed = true;
      for (const value of queue.splice(0)) release(value.bytes);
      return disposal ??= subscription?.dispose() ?? Promise.resolve();
    };
    const drain = () => {
      scheduled = false;
      if (closed) return;
      const value = queue.shift();
      if (!value) return;
      release(value.bytes);
      try { input.receive(value.snapshot, value.sources); }
      catch { void dispose().catch(() => {}); return; }
      if (queue.length) { scheduled = true; setImmediate(drain); }
    };
    subscription = await broker.subscribeCoreTelemetry({
      principal, sessionId: input.sessionId,
      channelIds: catalog.value.sources.channels.map((channel) => channel.channelId),
      intervalMs: input.intervalMs,
      receive(value) {
        if (closed || !subscription) return;
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value.sequence) || value.sequence <= last || value.snapshot.sessionId !== input.sessionId
          || value.sources.sessionId !== input.sessionId) { void dispose().catch(() => {}); return; }
        const copy = structuredClone(value);
        const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(copy), "utf8");
        const used = bytesByOwner.get(ownerKey) ?? 0;
        if (bytes > 65536 || used + bytes > 262144 || queue.length >= 64) {
          // No ACK of rejected data. Retire this demand; a new subscription
          // obtains a fresh snapshot. The broker retains recording gap evidence.
          void dispose().catch(() => {}); return;
        }
        queue.push({ ...copy, bytes }); bytesByOwner.set(ownerKey, used + bytes); last = value.sequence;
        subscription.ack(value.sequence); // bounded enqueue precedes ACK, callback follows it
        if (!scheduled) { scheduled = true; setImmediate(drain); }
      },
    });
    try {
      input.receive(subscription.initial.snapshot, subscription.initial.sources);
      subscription.activate();
    } catch (error) { await dispose(); throw error; }
    return dispose;
  } };
}
export function monitorProjection(sources: SourceCatalog, frame: TelemetryFrame): DeviceMonitorSnapshot {
  const value = (id: string): number | null => frame.status === "ok" ? frame.values.find((v) => v.channelId === id)?.value ?? null : null;
  const inputs: DeviceMonitorSnapshot["inputs"] = [], outputs: DeviceMonitorSnapshot["outputs"] = [];
  for (let port = 0; port < 4; port++) {
    const channels = sources.channels.filter((c) => c.kind === "input" && c.portId === `input:${port}`).sort((a, b) => a.component - b.component);
    const first = channels[0];
    if (first) inputs.push({ port, type: Number(first.typeId.split(":")[1]), connection: 122, mode: first.modeId ? Number(first.modeId.split(":")[1]) : -1, state: first.state, name: first.name, modeName: first.modeName, unit: first.unit, decimals: first.decimals, values: channels.map((c) => value(c.channelId)), switchable: first.state === "ready" });
    const output = sources.channels.find((c) => c.kind === "output-angle" && c.portId === `output:${port}`);

}
export class LegacyDevice {
  private candidates = new Map<string, DeviceCandidate>();

    const result = await this.dependencies.broker.request(this.dependencies.principal(), method, params, signal);
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message);
    return result.value as Extract<DeviceResult<M>, { ok: true }>["value"];
  }
  descriptor(id: string): DeviceDescriptor { const value = this.descriptors.get(id); if (!value) throw new Error("Unknown EV3 session."); return { ...value }; }

  }
  async connect(value: DeviceDescriptor, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
    const candidate = this.candidates.get(value.id);
    if (!candidate || value.metadata || value.serialNumber) throw new Error("Rediscover this EV3 candidate.");
    const { session } = await this.request("devices/connect", { target: { kind: "candidate", candidateId: candidate.candidateId } }, signal);
    this.descriptors.set(session.sessionId, { id: session.sessionId, name: session.name, transport: session.transport }); return session.sessionId;
  }
  async connectWifi(address: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
    const { session } = await this.request("devices/connect", { target: { kind: "wifi-address", providerId: "kobrixa.device-ev3", address } }, signal);
    this.descriptors.set(session.sessionId, { id: session.sessionId, name: session.name, transport: session.transport, address }); return session.sessionId;
  }
  async reconnectForRecovery(previousSessionId: Handle, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Handle> {
    const result = await this.dependencies.broker.reconnectForRecovery({ previousSessionId, signal });
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message);
    const { session } = await this.request("devices/session", { sessionId: result.value.sessionId }, signal);
    this.descriptors.delete(previousSessionId);
    this.descriptors.set(session.sessionId, { id: session.sessionId, name: session.name, transport: session.transport });
    return session.sessionId;
  }
  async disconnect(id: string): Promise<void> { await this.dependencies.disconnect(id); this.descriptors.delete(id); }
  async reset(): Promise<void> { for (const id of this.descriptors.keys()) await this.disconnect(id); }
  stop(id: string): Promise<void> { return this.dependencies.stop(id); }
  async monitor(id: string): Promise<MonitorResult<DeviceMonitorSnapshot>> {
    try {
      const { sources } = await this.request("devices/session", { sessionId: id });
      if (!sources.channels.length) return { status: "busy" };
      const snapshot = await this.request("devices/read", { sessionId: id, channelIds: sources.channels.map((c) => c.channelId), freshness: "fresh" });
      return snapshot.status === "fresh" && snapshot.frame ? { status: "ok", value: monitorProjection(sources, snapshot.frame) } : { status: "busy" };
    } catch (error) { return { status: "error", category: "device", message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }; }
  }
  async inputModes(id: string, port: number, type: number): Promise<MonitorResult<DeviceInputModes>> {
    try {
      const { sources } = await this.request("devices/session", { sessionId: id });
      const source = sources.channels.find((c) => c.portId === `input:${port}` && c.typeId === `ev3:${type}`); if (!source) throw new Error("Sensor source changed.");
      const value = await this.request("devices/inputModes/query", { sessionId: id, portId: source.portId!, expectedSourceRevision: sources.sourceRevision });
      return { status: "ok", value: { port, type, modes: value.modes.map((m) => ({ mode: Number(m.modeId.split(":")[1]), name: m.name })) } };
    } catch (error) { return { status: "error", category: "device", message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }; }
  }
  async setInputMode(id: string, port: number, type: number, mode: number): Promise<MonitorResult<DeviceMonitorSnapshot>> {
    try {
      const { sources } = await this.request("devices/session", { sessionId: id });
      const source = sources.channels.find((c) => c.portId === `input:${port}` && c.typeId === `ev3:${type}`);
      const context = this.dependencies.principal().authorityContext; if (!source || !context) throw new Error("Device authority unavailable.");
      const result = await this.request("devices/inputModes/set", { sessionId: id, portId: source.portId!, modeId: `mode:${mode}`, expectedSourceRevision: sources.sourceRevision, contextRef: context.ref });
      if (!result.snapshot.frame) return { status: "busy" };
      return { status: "ok", value: monitorProjection(result.sources, result.snapshot.frame) };
    } catch (error) { return { status: "error", category: "device", message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }; }
  }
  watch(id: string, intervalMs: 500 | 30000, receive: Parameters<LegacyMonitorFeed["subscribe"]>[0]["receive"]): Promise<() => Promise<void>> {
    return this.dependencies.feed.subscribe({ principal: this.dependencies.principal(), sessionId: id, intervalMs, receive });
  }
}
```

`createLegacyMonitorFeed` uses AM-07 `subscribeCoreTelemetry`. A-T2 charges the core JournalOwner identity against the common subscription/queue budgets and enforces the 10-second ACK deadline, owner/window retirement and shared sampler lifetime. Initial delivery precedes activation; callbacks run after bounded enqueue and ACK. A callback failure or overflow disposes only this demand. No ResourceOwner is fabricated and no polling timer is added.

```ts
  setInputMode(id: string, port: number, type: number, mode: number) { return this.ports.device.setInputMode(id, port, type, mode); }
  upload(id: string, buildId: string, remotePath: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(id, async (session, signal) => { const bytes = await this.builds.artifactBytes(buildId, signal); signal.throwIfAborted(); await session.upload(remotePath, bytes, signal); }, "deployment"));
  }
  deploy(id: string, buildId: string, remoteDirectory: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(id, async (session, signal) => {
      // BuildService verifies the complete immutable snapshot before any upload.
      const files = deploymentTargets(await this.builds.deployableArtifacts(buildId, signal), remoteDirectory);
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      const listings = new Map<string, RemoteEntry[]>();
      for (const file of files) {
        signal.throwIfAborted(); const checksum = createHash("md5").update(file.bytes).digest("hex");
        let unchanged = false;
        if (this.getPreferences().skipUnchangedAssets && file.role === "deploy-asset") {
          const directory = path.posix.dirname(file.remotePath);
          if (!listings.has(directory)) listings.set(directory, await session.list(directory, signal));
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const entry = listings.get(directory)!.find((value) => value.path === file.remotePath);
          unchanged = entry?.kind === "file" && entry.size === file.bytes.length && entry.checksum?.toLowerCase() === checksum;
        }
        if (!unchanged) await session.upload(file.remotePath, file.bytes, signal);
      }
      signal.throwIfAborted();
    }, "deployment"));
  }
  run(id: string, remotePath: string): Promise<void> { return this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(id, (session, signal) => session.run(remotePath, signal), "program-launch")); }
  stop(id: string): Promise<void> { return this.ports.device.stop(id); }
  delete(id: string, remotePath: string): Promise<void> { return this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(id, (session, signal) => session.delete(remotePath, signal), "file-write")); }
  async files(request: RemoteFileRequest): Promise<RemoteFileResult> {
    try {
      const { dialog } = await import("electron");
      return await this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(request.sessionId, (session, signal) => remoteFileOperation(request, session, signal, dialog,
        (paths) => this.send({ type: "files-changed", sessionId: request.sessionId, requestId: request.requestId, paths }),
        (transferred, total) => this.send({ type: "file-progress", sessionId: request.sessionId, requestId: request.requestId, transferred, total })),
        request.action === "list" || request.action === "download" ? "file-read" : "file-write"));
    } catch (error) { const value = normalizeDeviceError(error); return { ok: false, sessionId: request.sessionId, requestId: request.requestId, category: value.category, message: value.message }; }
  }
  async prepareFiles(request: FileBatchRequest, owner: WebContents): Promise<FileBatchSnapshot> {
    const current = (): CorePrincipal => {
      const value = this.ports.device.dependencies.principal();
      if (value.kind !== "core") throw new Error("Core file owner required.");
      return { ...value, adapter: "remote-files" };
    };
    const original = structuredClone(current());
    const { dialog } = await import("electron");
    this.batches ??= new FileBatchManager((id, work, operationClass) => this.track(() => this.ports.files.run(id, work, operationClass)), dialog,
      (snapshot) => {
        if (snapshot.phase !== "ready") renewals.delete(snapshot.planId);
        this.send({ type: "file-batch", snapshot });
      },
      (value, paths) => this.send({ type: "files-changed", sessionId: value.sessionId, requestId: value.requestId, paths }));
    if (!this.batchOwners.has(owner)) {
      this.batchOwners.add(owner); const id = owner.id;
      const abandon = () => {
        this.batches?.abandonOwner(id);
        for (const [key, entry] of renewals) if (entry.owner.hostEpoch === original.hostEpoch
          && entry.owner.workbenchInstance === original.workbenchInstance) renewals.delete(key);
      };
      owner.once("destroyed", abandon);
      owner.on("did-start-navigation", (_event, _url, _inPlace, mainFrame) => { if (mainFrame) abandon(); });
    }
    const snapshot = await this.batches.prepare(request, owner.id);
    if (snapshot.phase === "ready" && !owner.isDestroyed() && sameCore(original, current())) {
      const ref = { sessionId: snapshot.sessionId, requestId: snapshot.requestId, planId: snapshot.planId };
      renewals.set(ref.planId, { ref, owner: original, current,
        renew: () => { this.batches!.renew(ref, owner.id); } });
    }
    return snapshot;
  }
  executeFiles(ref: FileBatchRef, policy: "skip" | "replace", owner: number): Promise<FileBatchSnapshot> { if (!this.batches) throw new Error("Unknown file operation."); return this.batches.execute(ref, policy, owner); }
  stopFiles(ref: FileBatchRef, owner: number): Promise<void> { if (!this.batches) throw new Error("Unknown file operation."); return this.batches.stop(ref, owner); }
  renewFilePlan(ref: FileBatchRef, owner: CorePrincipal): void { renewFilePlan(ref, owner); }
}
```

The counter is display-only; it grants no device admission. T8 binds every call to a real workbench context, invokes the existing Lab flush before Disconnect, and supplies the stop/save/disconnect coordinator. There is no `withMotorTest` callback or raw session accessor. AM-08 supplies the host seam: A-T8 passes the current preference projection as `connectionPolicy` to `createDeviceBroker`; A-T2 captures it per attempt and schedules USB retries after loss of an established live session only. Each attempt uses `reconnectForRecovery({previousSessionId, signal})`, fresh discovery and the retained USB serial digest; the optional journal digest adds evidence. Reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous serials, stale native descriptors and IP-based matching. Preserve fixed 1/2/5/10-second or 1→2→5-second backoff and 3/5/10/unlimited limits, bounded by the 60-second attempt deadline. Disable, safe mode, explicit Disconnect, workbench retirement and preference cancellation abort the schedule and invalidate its previous-session alias. Restart journal loading never schedules reconnect or stop: explicit connection and observe/reconcile are allowed, while motion/upload/run remain blocked. No operation, launch, lease or authority is replayed.
