```ts
import type { LegacyDevice } from "../device-broker/legacy-device.js";
import { monitorProjection } from "../device-broker/legacy-device.js";
import type { MonitorUpdate } from "../../shared/sensor-lab.js";
export class MonitorService {
  private demands = new Map<string, { cancelled: boolean; ready: Promise<() => Promise<void>> }>();
  private updates = new Map<string, MonitorUpdate>();
  private listeners = new Set<(update: MonitorUpdate) => void>();
  private disposed = false;
  private sequence = 0;
  constructor(private devices: LegacyDevice, private publish: (update: MonitorUpdate) => void) {}
  latest = (id: string): MonitorUpdate | undefined => this.updates.get(id);
  get busy(): boolean { return false; }
  get recordingSession(): string | undefined { return undefined; }
  subscribe(listener: (update: MonitorUpdate) => void): () => void { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); }; }
  private emit(update: MonitorUpdate): void { this.updates.set(update.sessionId, update); this.publish(update); for (const listener of this.listeners) listener(update); }
  async watch(id: string, enabled: boolean, owner = 0): Promise<MonitorUpdate> {
    const key = `${owner}:${id}`;
    if (enabled && !this.demands.has(key)) {
      if (this.disposed) throw new Error("Monitor is closed.");
      const entry = { cancelled: false, ready: Promise.resolve(async () => {}) };
      this.demands.set(key, entry);
      entry.ready = this.devices.watch(id, 500, (snapshot, sources) => {
        if (entry.cancelled || this.disposed) return;
        const value = snapshot.frame && snapshot.status === "fresh" ? monitorProjection(sources, snapshot.frame) : undefined;
        this.emit({ sessionId: id, sequence: ++this.sequence, status: value ? "live" : "waiting", snapshot: value ?? this.latest(id)?.snapshot });
      });
      try { await entry.ready; } catch (error) { if (this.demands.get(key) === entry) this.demands.delete(key); throw error; }
    } else if (!enabled) {
      const entry = this.demands.get(key);
      if (entry) { entry.cancelled = true; this.demands.delete(key); await (await entry.ready)(); }
    }
    return this.latest(id) ?? { sessionId: id, sequence: this.sequence, status: "paused" };
  }
  inputModes(id: string, port: number, type: number) { return this.devices.inputModes(id, port, type); }
  setInputMode(id: string, port: number, type: number, mode: number) { return this.devices.setInputMode(id, port, type, mode); }
  async disconnect(id: string): Promise<void> {
    for (const [key, entry] of [...this.demands]) if (key.endsWith(`:${id}`)) { entry.cancelled = true; this.demands.delete(key); await (await entry.ready)(); }
    this.emit({ sessionId: id, sequence: ++this.sequence, status: "paused" }); this.updates.delete(id);
  }
  async pause(): Promise<void> { for (const [key, entry] of [...this.demands]) { entry.cancelled = true; this.demands.delete(key); await (await entry.ready)(); } }
  async dispose(): Promise<void> { this.disposed = true; await this.pause(); this.listeners.clear(); }
}
```

Lab no longer calls `MonitorService.acquire/release`; it uses the recording reservation adapter below. T8 switches that dependency atomically with this code. Battery calls `LegacyDevice.watch(id, 30000, receive)` through V150; neither renderer nor this service owns the hardware sampling clock.

```ts
import type { SourceCatalog, TelemetryFrame } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { MonitorUpdate, SensorChannel } from "../../shared/sensor-lab.js";
import { LegacyDevice, monitorProjection } from "./legacy-device.js";
type Active = { sessionId: string; reservationId: string; sources: SourceCatalog; sequence: number; remove: () => Promise<void>; reads: Promise<void>; reading: boolean; again: boolean };
export class LegacyLab {
  private active: Active | undefined;
  private opening = false;
  private updates = new Map<string, MonitorUpdate>();
  private updateSequence = 0;
  private ending: Promise<void> | undefined;
  constructor(private device: LegacyDevice, private publish: (update: MonitorUpdate) => void) {}
  latest = (id: string): MonitorUpdate | undefined => this.updates.get(id);
  descriptor = (id: string) => this.device.descriptor(id);
  private update(sessionId: string, status: MonitorUpdate["status"], snapshot?: MonitorUpdate["snapshot"]): void {
    const value: MonitorUpdate = { sessionId, sequence: ++this.updateSequence, status, recording: true, snapshot };
    this.updates.set(sessionId, value); this.publish(value);
  }
  private emit(active: Active, frame: TelemetryFrame): void {
    if (frame.sequence <= active.sequence) return;
    if (frame.sequence > active.sequence + 1 && active.sequence >= 0) this.update(active.sessionId, "waiting");
    active.sequence = frame.sequence;
    this.update(active.sessionId, frame.status === "ok" ? "live" : frame.status === "error" ? "error" : "waiting",
      frame.status === "ok" ? monitorProjection(active.sources, frame) : undefined);
  }
  private async read(active: Active, through?: number): Promise<void> {
    let target = through;
    for (;;) {
      if (target !== undefined && active.sequence >= target) return;
      const page = await this.device.request("devices/recording/read", { reservationId: active.reservationId, afterSequence: active.sequence, limit: 64 });
      target ??= page.reservation.lastSequence;
      if (target === undefined || !Number.isSafeInteger(target)) throw new Error("Invalid recording sequence.");
      if (page.gap && page.gap.toSequence > active.sequence) {
        this.update(active.sessionId, "waiting"); active.sequence = page.gap.toSequence;
      }
      for (const frame of page.frames) { if (frame.sequence > target) break; this.emit(active, frame); }
      if (!page.hasMore || active.sequence >= target) return;
      if (page.nextSequence <= active.sequence && !page.frames.length) throw new Error("Recording read made no progress.");
      active.sequence = Math.max(active.sequence, page.nextSequence);
    }
  }
  async acquire(sessionId: string, channels: SensorChannel[]): Promise<void> {
    if (this.active || this.opening || this.ending) throw new Error("A recording is already active.");
    this.opening = true;
    let reservationId: string | undefined;
    try {
      const { sources } = await this.device.request("devices/session", { sessionId });
      const channelIds = channels.map((old) => {
        const current = sources.channels.find((c) => c.portId === `${old.kind === "input" ? "input" : "output"}:${old.port}` && c.typeId === `ev3:${old.type}` && c.component === old.channel && (old.kind === "output" || c.modeId === `mode:${old.mode}`) && c.unit === old.unit);
        if (!current) throw new Error("Recording source changed."); return current.channelId;
      });
      const result = await this.device.request("devices/recording/reserve", { sessionId, channelIds, expectedSourceRevision: sources.sourceRevision });
      reservationId = result.reservation.reservationId;
      const active: Active = { sessionId, reservationId: result.reservation.reservationId, sources, sequence: result.firstFrame.sequence - 1, remove: async () => {}, reads: Promise.resolve(), reading: false, again: false };
      this.active = active; this.emit(active, result.firstFrame);
      active.remove = await this.device.watch(sessionId, 500, (snapshot, currentSources) => {
        if (this.active !== active) return;
        if (snapshot.status === "unavailable") { this.update(sessionId, "paused"); return; }
        const changed = result.reservation.channels.some((pinned) => !currentSources.channels.some((current) => current.channelId === pinned.channelId && current.typeId === pinned.typeId && current.modeId === pinned.modeId && current.unit === pinned.unit));
        if (changed) {
          // Let the unchanged legacy recorder detect the metadata change before
          // accepting any new-source sample. This never extends a reservation.
          if (snapshot.frame) this.update(sessionId, "live", monitorProjection(currentSources, snapshot.frame));
          else this.update(sessionId, "paused");
          return;
        }
        // Telemetry is only a wake-up. Read the original reservation ring so a
        // coalesced event cannot silently lose samples or overflow evidence.
        active.again = true;
        if (active.reading) return;
        active.reading = true;
        active.reads = (async () => {
          do { active.again = false; await this.read(active); } while (active.again && this.active === active);
        })().catch(() => { if (this.active === active) this.update(sessionId, "paused"); }).finally(() => { active.reading = false; });
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const active = this.active; this.active = undefined;
      if (reservationId) await this.device.request("devices/recording/release", { reservationId });
      await active?.remove(); throw error;
    } finally { this.opening = false; }
  }
  release(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (this.ending) return this.ending;
    const active = this.active; if (!active || active.sessionId !== sessionId) return Promise.resolve();
    this.active = undefined;
    const work = (async () => {
      const end = await this.device.request("devices/recording/release", { reservationId: active.reservationId });
      await active.reads;
      await this.read(active, end.reservation.lastSequence);
    })().finally(async () => { await active.remove(); this.ending = undefined; });
    this.ending = work; return work;
  }
}
```

T8 constructs `LegacyLab`, supplies `device: lab.descriptor`, `acquire: (id, channels) => lab.acquire(id, channels)`, `release: (id) => lab.release(id)`, `latest: lab.latest`, and routes its updates to `SensorLabService.observe`. The core coordinator preserves old Lab `flush()` in addition to any empty new-API persistence participant. A native recording release and a process retirement are different paths; this adapter never calls `resources.retire`.

```bash
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import type { DeviceRequestMap, MotionSnapshot } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { MotorTestRef, MotorTestRequest, MotorTestState } from "../../shared/motor-test.js";
''' + validators + '''type MotionMethod = "devices/motion/prepare" | "devices/motion/start" | "devices/motion/query" | "devices/motion/stop";
export interface MotorBrokerBindings {
  prepare(request: MotorTestRequest, sender: number): DeviceRequestMap["devices/motion/prepare"]["params"] | null;
  call<M extends MotionMethod>(method: M, params: DeviceRequestMap[M]["params"], sender: number): Promise<{ operation: MotionSnapshot }>;
  pulse(ref: MotorTestRef, sender: number): void;
  hasBlocker(): boolean;
}
interface Dependencies { bindings?: MotorBrokerBindings; publish(state: MotorTestState): void; }
interface Active { request: MotorTestRequest; owner: number; operationId: string | null; stop: boolean; brake: boolean; task: Promise<void>; }
const terminal = (phase: MotionSnapshot["phase"]) => ["completed", "stopped", "timeout", "failed", "unconfirmed"].includes(phase);
export class MotorTestService {
  private current: Active | undefined;
  private retained: Active | undefined;
  private state: MotorTestState = { phase: "idle", angle: null, displacement: null, elapsedMs: 0 };
  constructor(private dependencies: Dependencies) {}
  get busy(): boolean { return !!this.current; }
  getState = (): MotorTestState => structuredClone(this.state);
  private publish(): void { this.dependencies.publish(this.getState()); }
  private accept(active: Active, snapshot: MotionSnapshot): void {
    if (this.current !== active && this.retained !== active) return;
    this.state = { request: active.request, phase: snapshot.phase, angle: snapshot.angle, displacement: snapshot.displacement, elapsedMs: snapshot.elapsedMs,
      ...(snapshot.error ? { message: snapshot.error.message } : {}) };
    this.publish();
  }
  start(value: MotorTestRequest, owner: number): MotorTestState {
    const request = motorTestRequestSchema.parse(value) as MotorTestRequest;
    if (this.current) throw new Error("Another motor test is in progress.");
    const bindings = this.dependencies.bindings;
    const params = bindings?.prepare(request, owner);
    if (!bindings || !params) throw new Error("Motor UI binding unavailable.");
    const active: Active = { request, owner, operationId: null, stop: false, brake: request.brake, task: Promise.resolve() };
    this.current = active;
    this.state = { request, phase: "preparing", angle: null, displacement: null, elapsedMs: 0 }; this.publish();
    active.task = (async () => {
      const prepared = await bindings.call("devices/motion/prepare", params, owner);
      active.operationId = prepared.operation.operationId;
      let snapshot = active.stop
        ? (await bindings.call("devices/motion/stop", { operationId: active.operationId, stopMode: active.brake ? "brake" : "configured" }, owner)).operation
        : (await bindings.call("devices/motion/start", { operationId: active.operationId }, owner)).operation;
      this.accept(active, snapshot);
      while (!terminal(snapshot.phase)) {
        if (active.stop) await bindings.call("devices/motion/stop", { operationId: active.operationId, stopMode: active.brake ? "brake" : "configured" }, owner);
        await delay(150);
        snapshot = (await bindings.call("devices/motion/query", { operationId: active.operationId }, owner)).operation;
        this.accept(active, snapshot);
      }
    })().catch((error: unknown) => {
      this.state = { ...this.state, phase: active.operationId ? "unconfirmed" : "failed", message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }; this.publish();
    }).finally(() => { if (this.current === active) this.current = undefined; this.retained = active; });
    return this.getState();
  }
  keepAlive(ref: MotorTestRef, owner: number): void {
    const active = this.current;
    if (active && !active.stop && active.owner === owner && active.request.testId === ref.testId && active.request.sessionId === ref.sessionId) this.dependencies.bindings?.pulse(ref, owner);
  }
  async stop(ref: MotorTestRef, owner: number, brake = true): Promise<MotorTestState> {
    const active = this.current ?? this.retained;
    if (!active || active.request.testId !== ref.testId || active.request.sessionId !== ref.sessionId) return this.getState();
    if (active.owner !== owner) throw new Error("This motor test belongs to another window.");
    active.brake = active.stop ? active.brake || brake : brake; active.stop = true;
    if (active.operationId && this.dependencies.bindings) {
      const result = await this.dependencies.bindings.call("devices/motion/stop", { operationId: active.operationId, stopMode: active.brake ? "brake" : "configured" }, owner);
      this.accept(active, result.operation);
    }
    await active.task; return this.getState();
  }
  async stopAll(sessionId?: string): Promise<void> { const active = this.current ?? this.retained; if (active && (!sessionId || active.request.sessionId === sessionId)) await this.stop(active.request, active.owner, true); }
  async flush(): Promise<void> { await this.stopAll(); if (this.state.phase === "unconfirmed" || this.dependencies.bindings?.hasBlocker()) throw new Error("Device safety remains unconfirmed."); }
  disconnected(sessionId: string): void { const active = this.current; if (active?.request.sessionId === sessionId) { active.stop = true; active.brake = true; } }
  reconnected(_sessionId: string): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
}
''')
PY
```

`pulse` can only forward already validated trusted UI evidence. T8 supplies no production binding before the real UI lifetime port exists; private keepAlive cannot mint a scope or extend a revoked gesture. A lost start reply never causes another prepare/start. `reconnected` does not resolve a fault; the independent core recovery port does that after explicit evidence.

- [ ] **Step 11b: Attach battery/monitor/Lab demands and explicit renewal under V150 ownership**

A-T8 creates a battery-only `LegacyDevice` using `createLegacyDevice({ ...device.dependencies, principal: () => ({ ...principal(), adapter: "battery" }) })`; monitor and Lab similarly use `"monitor"` and `"lab"` identities while sharing `feed`. In main, retain one battery demand for the established session/workbench. On a connected `DeviceService` state event, call the following with the battery device; forward snapshots on the existing `device:monitor-update` event channel consumed by preload `onMonitor`. Dispose the old demand on connection replacement, Disconnect, navigation/window retirement and shutdown. Guard asynchronous acquisition with a generation so a late subscription immediately disposes itself. This uses no new public method or renderer timer.

```ts
let batteryGeneration = 0;
let removeBattery: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
async function attachBattery(sessionId: Handle | undefined): Promise<void> {
  const generation = ++batteryGeneration;
  const previous = removeBattery; removeBattery = undefined;
  await previous?.();
  if (!sessionId || generation !== batteryGeneration) return;
  const remove = await batteryDevice.watch(sessionId, 30000, (snapshot, sources) => {
    if (generation !== batteryGeneration || !snapshot.frame || snapshot.status !== "fresh") return;
    const renderer = trustedRenderer();
    if (!renderer || renderer.isDestroyed()) return;
    renderer.send("device:monitor-update", { sessionId, sequence: snapshot.frame.sequence,
      status: "live", snapshot: monitorProjection(sources, snapshot.frame) });
  });
  if (generation !== batteryGeneration) await remove(); else removeBattery = remove;
}
```

`devices.subscribe` invokes `attachBattery(event.sessionId)` only on connected state and `attachBattery(undefined)` on disconnected state; main's existing window/navigation teardown also invokes `attachBattery(undefined)`. A-T2 independently revokes demands on owner loss, so queued callbacks cannot keep sampling a retired workbench. The monitor IPC retains `monitor.watch(sessionId, enabled, event.sender.id)` and its own disposal; Lab's `LegacyLab.acquire/release` retains the reservation and ring cursor. Closing any one UI does not dispose the other demands.

Task 3A-T10 V150 Steps 11–15 in this plan exclusively implement `RemoteFilesController.renewConfirmation():Promise<void>`, its button and the single battery subscription mount. The controller forwards `device.renewFiles(ref)`; main retains `device:files-renew` and `DeviceService.renewFilePlan`. T8 Step 8a owns sender/window/authority validation. T5's existing repeated-renewal tests preserve the 600-second total deadline; T10 runs the real D150/V150 integration gate.

```ts
import type { Handle } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

export type AuthorityContextRecord = {
  ref: Handle;
  epoch: Handle;
  workbenchInstance: Handle;
  state: "local" | "joining" | "room" | "unsynced" | "invalid";
  roomBinding: Handle | null;
  connected: boolean;
  synced: boolean;
  role: "host" | "editor" | "viewer" | null;
  isHolder: boolean;
};
export interface AuthorityPort {
  current(principal: Principal, contextRef: Handle): AuthorityContextRecord | null;
  assertContinuation(principal: Principal, contextRef: Handle): void;
  subscribe(listener: (ref: Handle, epoch: Handle) => void): () => void;
}
```

A-RF3 and F02/F03/F05/F14 are pinned here: lack of a sender/report is unbound, a stale epoch never becomes local, and losing authority between two file chunks prevents the second chunk. Read and original-owner cleanup remain outside the mutation gate.

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/authority-context.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { z } from "zod";
import type { Handle, ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { DeviceAuthorityReport } from "../../shared/collab.js";
import type { AuthorityContextRecord, AuthorityPort } from "./authority-port.js";

const handle = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
export const authorityReportSchema = z.strictObject({
  document: handle,
  sequence: z.number().int().min(1).max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),
  state: z.enum(["local", "joining", "room", "unsynced", "invalid"]),
  roomId: z.string().min(1).max(160).nullable(),
  connected: z.boolean(), synced: z.boolean(),
  role: z.enum(["host", "editor", "viewer"]).nullable(), isHolder: z.boolean(),
}).superRefine((value, ctx) => {
  if (value.state === "local" && (value.roomId !== null || value.role !== null ||
      !value.connected || !value.synced || !value.isHolder))
    ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Local authority must be explicit." });
  if ((value.state === "room" || value.state === "joining" || value.state === "unsynced") &&
      (value.roomId === null || value.role === null))
    ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Room identity is required." });
});

type CoreAdapter = Extract<Principal, { kind: "core" }>["adapter"];
type Entry = { document: Handle; record: AuthorityContextRecord; sequence: number;
  reportKey: string; roomId: string | null; owners: Set<string> };
const ownerKey = (o: ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify([
  o.sourceKey, o.pluginId, o.generation, o.hostEpoch, o.processEpoch,
]);
export class AuthorityDenied extends Error {
  readonly code = "PLUGIN_E_DEVICE_AUTHORITY";
  readonly detail;
  constructor(reason: "unbound" | "joining" | "unsynced" | "viewer" | "not-holder" | "authority-changed") {
    super(reason);
    this.detail = { kind: "device" as const, reason, dispatch: "not-sent" as const,
      stopConfirmation: "not-required" as const };
  }
}
export class AuthorityContexts implements AuthorityPort {
  readonly #entries = new Map<number, Entry>();
  readonly #listeners = new Set<(ref: Handle, epoch: Handle) => void>();
  constructor(readonly hostEpoch: Handle, private readonly uuid: () => Handle = randomUUID) {}

  open(sender: number): Handle {
    const current = this.#entries.get(sender);
    if (current) return current.document;
    const record: AuthorityContextRecord = {
      ref: this.uuid(), epoch: this.uuid(), workbenchInstance: this.uuid(),
      state: "invalid", roomBinding: null, connected: false, synced: false,
      role: null, isHolder: false,
    };
    const entry: Entry = { document: this.uuid(), record, sequence: 0,
      reportKey: "", roomId: null, owners: new Set() };
    this.#entries.set(sender, entry);
    return entry.document;
  }
  report(sender: number, input: unknown): void {
    const report: DeviceAuthorityReport = authorityReportSchema.parse(input);
    const entry = this.#entries.get(sender);
    if (!entry || entry.document !== report.document) throw new Error("Stale authority document.");
    if (report.sequence <= entry.sequence) return;
    entry.sequence = report.sequence;
    const key = JSON.stringify([report.state, report.roomId, report.connected,
      report.synced, report.role, report.isHolder]);
    if (key === entry.reportKey) return;
    entry.reportKey = key;
    const roomBinding = report.roomId === null ? null :
      entry.roomId === report.roomId && entry.record.roomBinding !== null
        ? entry.record.roomBinding : this.uuid();
    entry.roomId = report.roomId;
    entry.record = Object.freeze({ ...entry.record, epoch: this.uuid(), roomBinding,
      state: report.state, connected: report.connected, synced: report.synced,
      role: report.role, isHolder: report.isHolder });
    this.#emit(entry.record);
  }
  core(sender: number, adapter: CoreAdapter): Extract<Principal, { kind: "core" }> {
    const entry = this.#entries.get(sender);
    if (!entry) throw new AuthorityDenied("unbound");
    return Object.freeze({ kind: "core", adapter, hostEpoch: this.hostEpoch,
      workbenchInstance: entry.record.workbenchInstance,
      authorityContext: Object.freeze({ ref: entry.record.ref, epoch: entry.record.epoch }) });
  }
  plugin(sender: number, owner: ResourceOwner): Extract<Principal, { kind: "plugin" }> {
    const entry = this.#entries.get(sender);
    if (!entry || owner.hostEpoch !== this.hostEpoch) throw new AuthorityDenied("unbound");
    entry.owners.add(ownerKey(owner));
    return Object.freeze({ kind: "plugin", owner: Object.freeze({ ...owner }),
      authorityContext: Object.freeze({ ref: entry.record.ref, epoch: entry.record.epoch }) });
  }
  unbind(owner: ResourceOwner): void {
    for (const entry of this.#entries.values()) entry.owners.delete(ownerKey(owner));
  }
  invalidate(sender: number): void {
    const entry = this.#entries.get(sender);
    if (!entry) return;
    this.#entries.delete(sender);
    this.#emit({ ...entry.record, epoch: this.uuid(), state: "invalid", isHolder: false });
  }
  current(principal: Principal, contextRef: Handle): AuthorityContextRecord | null {
    const binding = principal.authorityContext;
    if (!binding || binding.ref !== contextRef) return null;
    for (const entry of this.#entries.values()) {
      const record = entry.record;
      if (record.ref !== contextRef || record.epoch !== binding.epoch) continue;
      if (principal.kind === "core") {
        if (principal.hostEpoch !== this.hostEpoch ||
            principal.workbenchInstance !== record.workbenchInstance) return null;
      } else if (!entry.owners.has(ownerKey(principal.owner))) return null;
      return { ...record };
    }
    return null;
  }
  assertContinuation(principal: Principal, contextRef: Handle): void {
    if (!principal.authorityContext) throw new AuthorityDenied("unbound");
    const current = this.current(principal, contextRef);
    if (!current) throw new AuthorityDenied("authority-changed");
    if (current.state === "invalid") throw new AuthorityDenied("unbound");
    if (current.state === "joining") throw new AuthorityDenied("joining");
    if (current.state === "unsynced" || !current.connected || !current.synced)
      throw new AuthorityDenied("unsynced");
    if (current.state === "local") return;
    if (current.role === "viewer") throw new AuthorityDenied("viewer");
    if (!current.isHolder) throw new AuthorityDenied("not-holder");
  }
  subscribe(listener: (ref: Handle, epoch: Handle) => void): () => void {
    this.#listeners.add(listener);
    return () => { this.#listeners.delete(listener); };
  }
  #emit(record: AuthorityContextRecord): void {
    for (const listener of [...this.#listeners]) listener(record.ref, record.epoch);
  }
}
```

`current` returns a copy; the operation keeps its captured `Principal`. No continuation calls `core()` or `plugin()` to replace its epoch. `AuthorityDenied` describes the rejected next exchange; T2/T5 retain their original operation's sent/unknown/partial state when converting this exception to the final operation result.

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { WebContents } from "electron";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { IpcHandle } from "../ipc.js";
import { AuthorityContexts } from "../device-broker/authority-context.js";

export const DEVICE_CONTROL_DENIED = "Device control is held by another collaborator or is unavailable.";
const writes = new Set(["device:upload", "device:deploy", "device:run", "device:delete",
  "device:motor-test-start", "device:motor-test-keepalive", "device:set-input-mode"]);
const fileWrites = new Set(["upload", "mkdir", "rename", "delete"]);
type Sender = Pick<WebContents, "id" | "once">;
const actionOf = (value: unknown): unknown => value && typeof value === "object" && "action" in value
  ? value.action : undefined;
function batchKey(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
  const object = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return ["sessionId", "requestId", "planId"].every((key) => typeof object[key] === "string")
    ? JSON.stringify([object.sessionId, object.requestId, object.planId]) : null;
}
export class DeviceControlGate {
  readonly #watched = new Set<number>();
  readonly #downloads = new Map<number, string>();
  constructor(readonly contexts = new AuthorityContexts(randomUUID())) {}
  open(sender: Sender): { document: string } {
    if (!this.#watched.has(sender.id)) {
      this.#watched.add(sender.id);
      sender.once("destroyed", () => { this.invalidate(sender.id); this.#watched.delete(sender.id); });
    }
    return { document: this.contexts.open(sender.id) };
  }
  set(sender: Sender, report: unknown): void { this.contexts.report(sender.id, report); }
  invalidate(sender: number): void { this.#downloads.delete(sender); this.contexts.invalidate(sender); }
  principal(sender: number, adapter: Extract<Principal, { kind: "core" }>["adapter"]): Principal {
    return this.contexts.core(sender, adapter);
  }
  get(sender: number): boolean {
    try {
      const p = this.contexts.core(sender, "deployment");
      this.contexts.assertContinuation(p, p.authorityContext!.ref);
      return true;
    } catch { return false; }
  }
  rememberBatch(sender: Sender, snapshot: unknown): void {
    const key = batchKey(snapshot);
    if (actionOf(snapshot) === "download" && key) this.#downloads.set(sender.id, key);
    else this.#downloads.delete(sender.id);
  }
  assert(sender: number, channel: string, args: readonly unknown[]): void {
    const gated = writes.has(channel) ||
      (channel === "device:files" && fileWrites.has(String(actionOf(args[0])))) ||
      (channel === "device:files-prepare" && actionOf(args[0]) !== "download") ||
      (channel === "device:files-execute" && this.#downloads.get(sender) !== batchKey(args[0]));
    if (gated && !this.get(sender)) throw new Error(DEVICE_CONTROL_DENIED);
  }
}
export function registerDeviceControlIpc(
  handle: IpcHandle, gate: DeviceControlGate, onRevoke: () => Promise<void> = async () => {},
): void {
  handle("collab:device-control-context", (event) => gate.open(event.sender));
  handle("collab:set-device-control", async (event, report: unknown) => {
    const previous = gate.get(event.sender.id);
    gate.set(event.sender, report);
    if (previous && !gate.get(event.sender.id)) await onRevoke();
  });
}
```

The default gate is for isolated legacy fixtures. T8 supplies the one host-epoch registry; no filesystem lock is created here. The gate handles the first IPC admission only. T5 captures `gate.principal(...)` once and gives it to `LegacyOperationPort.begin`; the broker rechecks the same principal at each exchange.

```ts
type AuthorityApi = Pick<CollabApi, "deviceControlContext" | "setDeviceControl">;
export function useDeviceControl(
  store: CollabStore,
  api: AuthorityApi,
): { control: DeviceControl; state: DeviceControlSnapshot } | null {
  const session = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot);
  const [control, setControl] = useState<DeviceControl | null>(null);
  const document = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const sequence = useRef(0);
  const currentReport = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const send = useCallback((value: Omit<DeviceAuthorityReport, "document" | "sequence">) => {
    if (!document.current) return;
    const report = { ...value, document: document.current, sequence: ++sequence.current };
    try { void api.setDeviceControl(report).catch(() => undefined); } catch { /* teardown */ }
  }, [api]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let disposed = false;
    void api.deviceControlContext().then((value) => {
      if (disposed) return;
      document.current = value.document;
      currentReport.current();
    }).catch(() => { document.current = null; });
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      send({ state: "invalid", roomId: null, connected: false, synced: false, role: null, isHolder: false });
      document.current = null;
    };
  }, [api, send]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session) {
      setControl(null);
      currentReport.current = () => send({ state: "local", roomId: null,
        connected: true, synced: true, role: null, isHolder: true });
      currentReport.current();
      return;
    }
    const next = new DeviceControl(session);
    const reportState = () => {
      const snapshot = session.getSnapshot();
      const connected = snapshot.status === "connected";
      const state = connected && snapshot.synced ? "room" :
        snapshot.status === "connecting" || snapshot.status === "syncing" ? "joining" : "unsynced";
      send({ state, roomId: session.connection.roomId, connected, synced: snapshot.synced,
        role: snapshot.role, isHolder: next.getSnapshot().isHolder });
    };
    currentReport.current = reportState;
    const offControl = next.subscribe(reportState);
    const offSession = session.subscribe(reportState);
    reportState(); setControl(next);
    return () => { offControl(); offSession(); next.dispose(); };
  }, [session, send]);
  const current = control && control.session === session ? control : null;
  const state = useSyncExternalStore(current?.subscribe ?? subscribeNothing,
    current?.getSnapshot ?? getNothing);
  return current && state ? { control: current, state } : null;
}
```

A failed bridge never sends a compensating local report. Main invalidates on navigation/render loss even if React cleanup cannot run. Synchronous session/control observers send revocations before the next user-triggered device request. The document token prevents a delayed old document report from authorizing a replacement document. The whole report is trusted-renderer-only; a feature process has no report endpoint.

### Task 3A-T7: Attach device RPC to an immutable process owner and preserve cleanup lanes

**Files**

- Modify (T0-created): `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/rpc-router.ts`.
- Create: `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/rpc-router.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/rpc-bindings.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/rpc-bindings.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/lifecycle-adapter.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/lifecycle-adapter.test.ts`.
- Test: the three test files above.

**Interfaces**

Consumes `RpcPeer`, `RequestContext { readonly signal: AbortSignal; afterReply(published: () => void, abandoned: () => void): void }`, the published `requestMethods`, and the exact T2 port:

```ts
type DeviceMethod = keyof DeviceRequestMap;
type DeviceParams<M extends DeviceMethod> = DeviceRequestMap[M]["params"];
type DeviceResult<M extends DeviceMethod> = DeviceRequestMap[M]["result"];
interface DeviceBrokerPort {
  readonly intent: DeviceIntentPort;
  readonly reservations: ReservationBindingPort;
  readonly sessions: DeviceSessionControlPort;
  readonly resources: DeviceResourceParticipant;
  readonly recovery: DeviceRecoveryPort;
  readonly events: CommonEventLedgerPort;
  providerCatalog(providerId: string): ProviderCatalogPort;
  attachChannel(input: { owner: ResourceOwner; principal: () => Principal;
    send: (event: Stage3EventEnvelope) => void }): DeviceChannelAttachment;
  request<M extends DeviceMethod>(principal: Principal, method: M,
    params: DeviceParams<M>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DeviceResult<M>>;
  legacy(principal: Principal, sessionId: Handle, request: LegacyProviderRequest,
    signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ProviderOutcome<LegacyProviderValue>>;
  registerProvider(provider: BuiltinDeviceProvider): () => void;
}
```

Produces exactly:

```ts
function attachDeviceRpc(input: {
  peer: RpcPeer;
  principal: () => Principal;
  broker: DeviceBrokerPort;
}): () => void;
```

The local `DeviceRpcBinding` captures the full owner once; it can read a freshly host-bound authority reference for **a new request**, never for a continuation. `classifyCleanup` is a host-only pre-lifecycle classifier. Its lookup callbacks must read the original broker registry, not wire fields. T2 remains the sole permission/capability/handle/admission implementation. It evaluates wire validation → caller binding/version → permission → source lifecycle → handle ownership/session → capability → operation-class gate → authority/UI scope → journal health/quarantine → reservation/foreground conflict. A matching original-owner safety capability is classified before the generic lifecycle gate; an invalid or foreign reference does not acquire that exception.

W1 uses real `RpcPeer` with bound fake brokers and frozen DTOs; R150 owns manager/process attachment and T9 owns actual integrated public-path conformance. Do not edit `manager.ts`, `peer.ts`, `methods.ts` or SDKs here. A-RF4, F02/F03/F04/F13/F17/F18/F19 are the local negative matrix.

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement immutable channel bindings and the narrow cleanup classifier**

Create `rpc-bindings.ts`:

```ts
import { RPC_ERRORS, RpcError } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

export function ownerKey(principal: Principal): string {
  return principal.kind === "plugin" ? JSON.stringify(["plugin", principal.owner.sourceKey,
    principal.owner.pluginId, principal.owner.generation, principal.owner.hostEpoch,
    principal.owner.processEpoch]) : JSON.stringify(["core", principal.adapter,
    principal.hostEpoch, principal.workbenchInstance]);
}
function capture(principal: Principal): Principal {
  const authorityContext = principal.authorityContext ? Object.freeze({ ...principal.authorityContext }) : null;
  return principal.kind === "plugin"
    ? Object.freeze({ kind: "plugin", owner: Object.freeze({ ...principal.owner }), authorityContext })
    : Object.freeze({ ...principal, authorityContext });
}
export class DeviceRpcBinding {
  readonly #owner: string;
  #closed = false;
  constructor(private readonly principal: () => Principal) { this.#owner = ownerKey(principal()); }
  capture(): Principal {
    if (this.#closed) throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.connectionClosed, "Device channel closed.");
    const principal = capture(this.principal());
    if (ownerKey(principal) !== this.#owner)
      throw new RpcError(RPC_ERRORS.invalidRequest, "Device channel owner changed.");
    return principal;
  }
  close(): void { this.#closed = true; }
}
```

Create `lifecycle-adapter.ts`:

```ts
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DeviceDrainGrant, DeviceResourceParticipant, Principal, RetirementReason } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { ownerKey } from "./rpc-bindings.js";

export type CleanupClass = "closed" | "ordinary" | "original-motion" | "final-read";
export interface CleanupLookup {
  operationOwner(operationId: string): Principal | null;
  drain(reservationId: string): DeviceDrainGrant | null;
}
export function classifyCleanup(
  principal: Principal, method: string, params: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  channelOpen: boolean, now: number, lookup: CleanupLookup,
): CleanupClass {
  if (!channelOpen) return "closed";
  if ((method === "devices/motion/query" || method === "devices/motion/stop") &&
      typeof params.operationId === "string") {
    const original = lookup.operationOwner(params.operationId);
    if (original && ownerKey(original) === ownerKey(principal)) return "original-motion";
  }
  if (principal.kind === "plugin" &&
      (method === "devices/recording/query" || method === "devices/recording/read") &&
      typeof params.reservationId === "string") {
    const grant = lookup.drain(params.reservationId);
    if (!grant || now >= grant.expiresMonotonicMs) return "ordinary";
    const bound: Principal = { kind: "plugin", owner: grant.owner, authorityContext: null };
    if (ownerKey(bound) !== ownerKey(principal)) return "ordinary";
    if (method === "devices/recording/read" &&
        (typeof params.afterSequence !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(params.afterSequence) ||
        params.afterSequence < 0 || params.afterSequence > grant.lastSequence)) return "ordinary";
    return "final-read";
  }
  return "ordinary";
}
export function retireDeviceOwner(
  resources: DeviceResourceParticipant, owner: ResourceOwner, reason: RetirementReason,
): ReturnType<DeviceResourceParticipant["retire"]> {
  return resources.retire(owner, reason);
}
```

`final-read` is an admission classification, not a returned sample filter. T2 still checks the reservation/session/provider generation and clips output to `grant.lastSequence`; it also enforces the original monotonic expiry after every await. R150 must not pre-reject these original-channel calls with its generic disabled check. A boolean classification cannot authorize arbitrary operation IDs or reuse an expired grant.

Replace the T0 declaration in `rpc-router.ts`:

```ts
import { deviceRequestSchemas, eventEnvelopeSchema, requestMethods, type RequestContext, type RpcPeer } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { DeviceBrokerPort, DeviceMethod, DeviceParams, DeviceResult } from "./broker-port.js";
import { DeviceRpcBinding } from "./rpc-bindings.js";

const attachedPeers = new WeakSet<RpcPeer>();
export function attachDeviceRpc(input: {
  peer: RpcPeer;
  principal: () => Principal;
  broker: DeviceBrokerPort;
}): () => void {
  if (attachedPeers.has(input.peer)) throw new Error("Device/common-event RPC is already attached to this peer.");
  const binding = new DeviceRpcBinding(input.principal);
  const original = binding.capture();
  if (original.kind !== "plugin") throw new Error("Device RPC requires a plugin channel owner.");
  const channel = input.broker.attachChannel({ owner: original.owner,
    principal: () => binding.capture(),
    send(event) {
      binding.capture();
      if (input.peer.closed) throw new Error("Device channel closed.");
      input.peer.notify("events/deliver", eventEnvelopeSchema.parse(event));
    },
  });
  attachedPeers.add(input.peer);
  // RpcPeer validates each published schema before invoking this typed bridge.
  // The domain map uses schema-inferred inputs/results; RpcPeer.handle accepts z.input results.
  const register = input.peer.handle.bind(input.peer) as <M extends DeviceMethod>(
    method: M,
    handler: (params: DeviceParams<M>, context: RequestContext) => Promise<DeviceResult<M>>,
  ) => void;
  for (const method of Object.keys(deviceRequestSchemas)) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(requestMethods, method)) continue;
    const name = method as DeviceMethod;
    register(name, async (params, context) => {
      const principal = binding.capture();
      const result = await input.broker.request(principal, name, params, context.signal);
      if (result.ok && name === "devices/negotiate") {
        context.afterReply(() => channel.negotiated("devices", 1), () => {});
      }
      if (result.ok && name === "devices/subscribe" && "subscriptionId" in result.value) {
        const subscriptionId = result.value.subscriptionId;
        context.afterReply(() => channel.activate(subscriptionId), () => channel.abandon(subscriptionId));
      }
      return result;
    });
  }
  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true; binding.close(); channel.dispose();
  };
}
```

No method is registered from caller strings, no `devices.provide` route is added, and this adapter never manufactures a cancelled/not-sent result after broker acceptance. Existing `RpcPeer` may return a transport cancellation after its incoming signal aborts; accepted-operation state must remain queryable in the broker and terminal events. The adapter never retries start to obtain another reply, and does not claim that an aborted RPC must deliver a business result. Disposing makes existing handlers fail closed because existing `RpcPeer.handle` has no unregister operation; it does not close other domains sharing the peer. The real manager closes the peer after disposition/process teardown. A new execution must create a new peer and `DeviceRpcBinding`, even if pluginId/generation happen to match an old host.

The A domain map includes common `events/ack` and `events/unsubscribe`; this factory installs them once. B1/B2 reuse the attached channel and `broker.events`, recording their own successful domain negotiation and registering the same after-reply activation/abandon pair. T2 checks the current full owner and negotiated kind before calling the sink, and retires delivery if schema validation, `peer.closed`, or synchronous notify/send throws. All subscriptions start inactive. T1 invokes abandoned on validation, cancellation, close or send failure and never invokes published for a numeric error; callbacks cannot rewrite a sent reply. No resolved-handler microtask is a publication barrier. Disposal clears sinks, queues, subscriptions and negotiation state while retaining durable safety evidence.

```ts
interface ProfileWriterLock { readonly hostEpoch: Handle; assertHeld(): void }
interface DeviceResourceParticipant {
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: RetirementReason): {
    drain: DeviceDrainGrant | null; settled: Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  };
  retireProvider(providerId: string, providerGeneration: Counter): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  beginShutdown(): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
}
interface ReservationBindingPort {
  validate(owner: ResourceOwner, reservationId: Handle): ReservationBinding | null;
  onEnded(listener: (event: ReservationEnded) => void): () => void;
}
interface DeviceSessionControlPort {
  quiesce(sessionId: Handle, cause: SessionQuiesceCause): SessionQuiescence;
  disconnect(sessionId: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<BusinessResult<
    { sessionId: Handle; disconnected: true }, DeviceErrorDetail | PermissionErrorDetail | ResourceErrorDetail
  >>;
  resume(sessionId: Handle): void;
}
interface PersistenceParticipant {
  endReservation(event: ReservationEnded, deadline: number): DrainOffer | null;
  freeze(owner: PersistenceOwner, reason: DrainReason, deadline: number,
    deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant): DrainOffer;
  drain(offer: DrainOffer, dispatch: DrainDispatcher): Promise<DrainReport>;
  ownerLost(owner: PersistenceOwner): Promise<DrainReport>;
  recoverySnapshot(): PersistenceRecoverySnapshot;
  retry(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
  discard(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
}
```

It does not invent `StorageDrainPort`/`DrainSession`, add renderer-selected owners, or publish 1.6/1.7 methods. T0 seeded the runtime lock declaration; H-R exports it type-only. The production journal and later persistence receive the **same object** and `hostEpoch`.

Preserve these appendix values: storage drain ≤10,000 ms shared across owners; stop/readback ≤15,000 ms including the already-started file exchange; final journal ≤5,000 ms after stop; manager cleanup ≤4,000 ms including its 2,000 ms shutdown request; `max(10,15+5)+4=24` seconds cleanup; 25 seconds outer safety net. A timer only records uncertainty. It never means physical stop, saved data, successful process exit, or permission to release the profile lock.

A-RF5 and F17/F19 require end-before/during/after durable checkpoint registration, one original deadline, same-turn retire/freeze, pending-final session indexing, and healthy consumer survival for Disconnect/suspend/provider loss. The real persistence registration race belongs to B2-T5/X-T1; the coordinator tests below inject that race at its port boundary and explicitly do not replace U12 actual-persistence acceptance.

```ts
// packages/plugin-runtime/src/profile-writer-lock.ts
import type { Handle } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
export interface ProfileWriterLock {
  readonly hostEpoch: Handle;
```

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/profile-writer-lock.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { ProfileWriterLock } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

export interface PrimaryHost {
  requestSingleInstanceLock(): boolean;
  hasSingleInstanceLock(): boolean;
  whenReady(): Promise<void>;
  quit(): void;
  on(name: "second-instance" | "quit", listener: () => void): unknown;
}
export function startPrimary(
  app: PrimaryHost, start: (profile: ProfileWriterLock) => Promise<void>, focus: () => boolean,
): { profile: ProfileWriterLock; ready: Promise<void>; windowReady(): void } | null {
  if (!app.requestSingleInstanceLock()) { app.quit(); return null; }
  let held = true;
  let pendingFocus = false;
  const profile: ProfileWriterLock = Object.freeze({
    hostEpoch: randomUUID(),
    assertHeld() {
      if (!held || !app.hasSingleInstanceLock()) throw new Error("Primary profile writer lock is not held.");
    },
  });
  app.on("second-instance", () => { pendingFocus = !focus(); });
  app.on("quit", () => { held = false; });
  const ready = app.whenReady().then(() => { profile.assertHeld(); return start(profile); });
  return { profile, ready, windowReady() {
    if (pendingFocus && focus()) pendingFocus = false;
  } };
}
```

Do not call `releaseSingleInstanceLock()`. Electron releases the OS lock on exit, after the worker/process lifetime ends. Imports may declare classes before this gate, but no imported module may construct providers, write profile state, launch processes/workers, or create windows as a module side effect.

```ts
import type { Handle, ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { CoreActionReference, DeviceDisposition, DeviceResourceParticipant,
  DeviceSessionControlPort, ReservationBindingPort, ReservationEnded, RetirementReason,
  PersistenceParticipant, DrainDispatcher, DrainOffer, DrainReason, DrainReport } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

import { retireStage3Owner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { Stage3RuntimePorts, OwnerRetirement } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
const ownerKey = (o: ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify([o.sourceKey, o.pluginId, o.generation, o.hostEpoch, o.processEpoch]);
const saved = (): DrainReport => ({ state: "saved", blocker: false, pendingSettings: false, records: [], errors: [] });
function uncertain(message: string): DrainReport {
  return { state: "uncertain", blocker: true, pendingSettings: false, records: [],
    errors: [{ code: "PLUGIN_E_TIMEOUT", message }] };
}
export class CleanupBlocked extends Error {
  constructor(readonly device: DeviceDisposition | null, readonly storage: readonly DrainReport[]) {
    super("Device or persistence disposition is incomplete.");
  }
}
export interface CoordinatorInput {
  ports: Stage3RuntimePorts;
  resources: DeviceResourceParticipant;
  sessions: DeviceSessionControlPort;
  reservations: ReservationBindingPort;
  persistence: PersistenceParticipant;
  dispatch: DrainDispatcher;
  alive(owner: ResourceOwner): boolean;
  owners(): readonly ResourceOwner[];
  now(): number;
  shutdown(): Promise<void>;
  legacyFlush(reason: "close" | "update" | "suspend"): Promise<void>;
  report(error: unknown): void;
}
type EndWork = { event: ReservationEnded; offer: DrainOffer | null; promise: Promise<DrainReport>;
  resolve(report: DrainReport): void; terminal: boolean };
type RetirementWork = { device: Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  storage: Promise<DrainReport>; done: Promise<void> };
export class LifecycleCoordinator {
  readonly #ends = new Map<string, EndWork>();
  readonly #retiring = new Map<string, RetirementWork>();
  readonly #suspending = new Map<Handle, Promise<void>>();
  readonly #disconnecting = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
  readonly #off: () => void;
  #close: Promise<void> | undefined;
  #closeStarted: number | undefined;
  #closed = false;
  constructor(private readonly input: CoordinatorInput) {
    if (input.ports.device !== input.resources || input.ports.persistence !== input.persistence)
      throw new Error("Coordinator must share the runtime participants.");
    this.#off = input.reservations.onEnded((event) => this.#ended(event));
  }
  #bounded<T>(work: Promise<T>, deadline: number, message: string): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), Math.max(0, deadline - this.input.now()));
      work.then((value) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(value); },
        (error: unknown) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); });
    });
  }
  #observe(work: Promise<DrainReport>, deadline: number): Promise<DrainReport> {
    return this.#bounded(work, deadline, "Persistence final drain deadline expired.")
      .catch((error: unknown) => { this.input.report(error); return uncertain("Persistence final drain is unconfirmed."); });
  }
  #ended(event: ReservationEnded): void {
    const key = `${ownerKey(event.owner)}:${event.reservationId}`;
    if (this.#ends.has(key)) return;
    const deadline = Math.min(event.endedMonotonicMs + 10_000,
      event.drain?.expiresMonotonicMs ?? event.endedMonotonicMs + 10_000,
      this.#closeStarted === undefined ? Infinity : this.#closeStarted + 10_000);
    // This synchronous call fences pending registration before any dispatch or await.
    const offer = this.input.persistence.endReservation(event, deadline);
    let resolve!: (report: DrainReport) => void;
    const promise = new Promise<DrainReport>((done) => { resolve = done; });
    const work: EndWork = { event, offer, promise, resolve, terminal: false };
    this.#ends.set(key, work);
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const retirement = this.#retiring.get(ownerKey(event.owner));
      const pending = retirement ? retirement.storage : !offer ? Promise.resolve(saved()) :
        !event.drain || !this.input.alive(event.owner)
          ? this.input.persistence.ownerLost(event.owner)
          : this.input.persistence.drain(offer, this.input.dispatch);
      void this.#observe(pending, offer?.deadlineMonotonicMs ?? deadline).then((report) => {
        work.terminal = report.state === "saved" && !report.blocker;
        resolve(report);
        // Unresolved evidence is never evicted; persistence enforces its 64-host recovery cap.
        // Only successful terminal receipts count toward this bounded dedupe cache.
        const terminal = [...this.#ends.entries()].filter(([, item]) => item.terminal);
        for (const [oldKey] of terminal.slice(0, Math.max(0, terminal.length - 256))) this.#ends.delete(oldKey);
      });
    });
  }
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: OwnerRetirement, deadlineMonotonicMs?: number): Promise<void> {
    const key = ownerKey(owner), existing = this.#retiring.get(key);
    if (existing) return existing.done;
    const t0 = this.input.now();
    const receipt = retireStage3Owner(this.input.ports, owner,
      this.input.alive(owner) ? reason : "crashed", this.input.now,
      this.input.dispatch, deadlineMonotonicMs);
    const device = this.#bounded(receipt.then(value => value.device), t0 + 20_000,
      "Device stop/journal deadline expired.");
    const storage = receipt.then(value => value.persistence);
    const done = Promise.all([device, storage]).then(([d, report]) => this.#assert(d, [report]));
    this.#retiring.set(key, { device, storage, done });
    void done.catch((error: unknown) => this.input.report(error));
    return done;
  }
  #assert(device: DeviceDisposition, storage: readonly DrainReport[]): void {
    if (!device.stopConfirmed || !device.journalCommitted || storage.some((report) =>
      report.blocker || report.state !== "saved" || report.pendingSettings ||
      report.errors.length > 0 || report.records.some((record) => !record.final || record.committedRevision === null)))
      throw new CleanupBlocked(device, storage);
  }
  async #sessionReports(sessionId: Handle): Promise<DrainReport[]> {
    return Promise.all([...this.#ends.values()].filter((work) => work.event.sessionId === sessionId)
      .map((work) => work.promise));
  }
  disconnect(sessionId: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<void> {
    const key = `${sessionId}:${action.scope.hostEpoch}:${action.scope.workbenchInstance}:${action.actionToken}`;
    const existing = this.#disconnecting.get(key); if (existing) return existing;
    if (this.#disconnecting.size >= 256) return Promise.reject(new Error("Disconnect receipt capacity reached."));
    const work = this.#disconnect(sessionId, action);
    this.#disconnecting.set(key, work);
    return work;
  }
  async #disconnect(sessionId: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<void> {
    const t0 = this.input.now();
    const quiescence = this.input.sessions.quiesce(sessionId, { reason: "core-disconnect", action });
    // onEnded already saw these events; duplicate calls only reconcile the indexed evidence.
    for (const event of quiescence.ended) this.#ended(event);
    const [device, storage] = await Promise.all([
      this.#bounded(quiescence.settled, t0 + 20_000, "Disconnect stop/journal deadline expired."),
      this.#sessionReports(sessionId), this.input.legacyFlush("close"),
    ]);
    this.#assert(device, storage);
    const result = await this.input.sessions.disconnect(sessionId, action);
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message);
  }
  suspend(sessionId: Handle): Promise<void> {
    const existing = this.#suspending.get(sessionId); if (existing) return existing;
    const t0 = this.input.now();
    const quiescence = this.input.sessions.quiesce(sessionId, { reason: "suspended" });
    for (const event of quiescence.ended) this.#ended(event);
    const work = Promise.all([
      this.#bounded(quiescence.settled, t0 + 20_000, "Suspend stop/journal deadline expired."),
      this.#sessionReports(sessionId), this.input.legacyFlush("suspend"),
    ]).then(([device, storage]) => this.#assert(device, storage));
    this.#suspending.set(sessionId, work);
    void work.catch((error: unknown) => this.input.report(error));
    return work;
  }
  async resume(sessionId: Handle): Promise<void> {
    const work = this.#suspending.get(sessionId); if (!work) return;
    await work; this.input.sessions.resume(sessionId); this.#suspending.delete(sessionId);
  }
  close(reason: "close" | "update"): Promise<void> {
    if (this.#closed) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.#close) return this.#close;
    this.#closeStarted ??= this.input.now();
    const t0 = this.#closeStarted;
    // beginShutdown synchronously closes the host admission gate before returning its promise.
    const device = this.input.resources.beginShutdown();
    const owners = this.input.owners().map((owner) => this.retire(owner,
      reason === "update" ? "update" : "shutdown", t0 + 10_000));
    const legacy = this.input.legacyFlush(reason);
    const attempt = Promise.all([
      this.#bounded(device, t0 + 20_000, "Host stop/journal deadline expired."),
      Promise.all(owners), this.#bounded(legacy, t0 + 10_000, "Legacy Lab save deadline expired."),
      Promise.all([...this.#ends.values()].map((work) => work.promise)),
    ]).then(async ([d, , , reports]) => {
      this.#assert(d, reports);
      await this.#bounded(this.input.shutdown(), Math.min(t0 + 24_000, this.input.now() + 4_000),
        "Plugin process exit is unconfirmed.");
    });
    const bounded = this.#bounded(attempt, t0 + 25_000, "Close safety net expired; cleanup remains blocked.");
    this.#close = bounded;
    void bounded.then(() => { this.#close = undefined; this.#closed = true; }, (error: unknown) => {
      this.#close = undefined; this.input.report(error);
    });
    return bounded;
  }
  dispose(): void { this.#off(); }
}
```

`dispose()` is called only after successful process/provider teardown. Failed close does not call it. A new close attempt retains the original `#closeStarted`, retired owners and grants; it cannot buy another drain window. A failure requiring explicit core recovery remains blocked until the recovery owner reconciles it; B1-T5/D170 extend this same coordinator with that ledger, not a second listener. No code here equates `storage/drain`'s callback receipt with a final durable `DrainReport`.

Before leaving this cycle, add the explicit resource-free adapter below to the same `lifecycle-coordinator.ts` file. Add `import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";` and the type-only `DeviceDrainGrant` import. Its proof callback comes from the host registry; absence of the real persistence adapter is never itself proof of an empty owner.

```ts
export function createResourceFreePersistence(isResourceFree: (owner: ResourceOwner) => boolean): PersistenceParticipant {
  const offers = new Map<string, DrainOffer>();
  const known = new WeakSet<DrainOffer>();
  const blocked = new Map<string, { owner: ResourceOwner; recovery: Handle }>();
  let revision = 0;
  const report = (owner: ResourceOwner): DrainReport => {
    const item = blocked.get(ownerKey(owner));
    if (!item && isResourceFree(owner)) return saved();
    return { state: "checkpoint-only", blocker: true, pendingSettings: false, records: [],
      ...(item ? { recovery: item.recovery } : {}),
      errors: [{ code: "PLUGIN_E_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Persistence adapter is unavailable for this resource owner." }] };
  };
  const block = (owner: ResourceOwner): void => {
    const key = ownerKey(owner);
    if (blocked.has(key)) return;
    if (blocked.size >= 64) throw new Error("Persistence recovery capacity reached.");
    blocked.set(key, { owner: { ...owner }, recovery: randomUUID() }); revision++;
  };
  const offer = (owner: ResourceOwner, reason: DrainReason, deadline: number, key: string): DrainOffer => {
    const previous = offers.get(key); if (previous) return previous;
    if (offers.size >= 256) throw new Error("Resource-free participant receipt capacity reached.");
    const value: DrainOffer = Object.freeze({ owner: Object.freeze({ ...owner }), reason,
      deadlineMonotonicMs: deadline, token: randomUUID(), checkpoints: [], writes: [], acceptedTickets: [] });
    offers.set(key, value); known.add(value); return value;
  };
  return {
    endReservation(event, deadline) {
      // Seeing a reservation means this owner is outside this adapter's resource-free allowance.
      block(event.owner);
      return offer(event.owner, "reservation-ended", Math.min(deadline, event.endedMonotonicMs + 10_000,
        event.drain?.expiresMonotonicMs ?? Infinity), `${ownerKey(event.owner)}:${event.reservationId}`);
    },
    freeze(owner, reason, deadline, deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant) {
      if (reason === "reservation-ended") throw new Error("Reservation end is not owner retirement.");
      if (deviceDrain || !isResourceFree(owner)) block(owner);
      return offer(owner, reason, Math.min(deadline, deviceDrain?.expiresMonotonicMs ?? Infinity), ownerKey(owner));
    },
    async drain(value) {
      if (!known.has(value)) throw new Error("Foreign drain offer.");
      return report(value.owner);
    },
    async ownerLost(owner) {
      if (!isResourceFree(owner)) block(owner);
      return report(owner);
    },
    recoverySnapshot() {
      return { revision, items: [...blocked.values()].map(({ owner, recovery }) => ({
        id: recovery, sourceKey: owner.sourceKey, pluginId: owner.pluginId, recordId: null,
        committedRevision: null, state: "checkpoint-only" as const, payload: "none" as const, actions: [],
      })) };
    },
    async retry() { throw new Error("Persistence recovery adapter is unavailable."); },
    async discard() { throw new Error("Persistence recovery adapter is unavailable."); },
  };
}
```

Replace `main/plugins/quit.ts`:

```ts
export const PLUGIN_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 25_000;
interface QuitHost {
  on(event: "will-quit", listener: (event: { preventDefault(): void }) => void): unknown;
  quit(): void;
}
export function installPluginQuitCleanup(
  app: QuitHost, cleanup: () => Promise<void>, blocked: (error: unknown) => void,
): void {
  let state: "idle" | "cleaning" | "done" = "idle";
  app.on("will-quit", (event) => {
    if (state === "done") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (state === "cleaning") return;
    state = "cleaning";
    let timedOut = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      blocked(new Error("Cleanup disposition is still unknown after 25 seconds."));
      // Keep state cleaning: late callbacks cannot turn this attempt into automatic quit.
    }, PLUGIN_QUIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    void Promise.resolve().then(cleanup).then(() => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (timedOut) { state = "idle"; return; }
      state = "done"; app.quit();
    }, (error: unknown) => {
      clearTimeout(timer); state = "idle"; blocked(error);
    });
  });
}
```

Scope equality checks both fields; target equality checks every member, including session, fault and evidence. Copy targets at mint so later mutation cannot widen an action.

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from "node:util";
import type { CoreActionReference, CoreActionTarget, CoreActionValidationPort,
  CoreWindowScope } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

export interface CoreActionLedger extends CoreActionValidationPort {
  mint(scope: CoreWindowScope, target: CoreActionTarget): CoreActionReference;
  retire(scope: CoreWindowScope): void;
}
export function createCoreActionLedger(input: {
  now: () => number; current: (scope: CoreWindowScope) => boolean;
}): CoreActionLedger {
  type Entry = { action: CoreActionReference; target: CoreActionTarget;
    expires: number; claimed: boolean };
  const entries = new Map<string, Entry>();
  const sameScope = (a: CoreWindowScope, b: CoreWindowScope) =>
    a.hostEpoch === b.hostEpoch && a.workbenchInstance === b.workbenchInstance;
  const lookup = (action: CoreActionReference, target?: CoreActionTarget) => {
    const entry = entries.get(action.actionToken);
    if (!entry || !sameScope(entry.action.scope, action.scope)) return undefined;
    if (!input.current(entry.action.scope) || (!entry.claimed && input.now() >= entry.expires)) {
      entries.delete(action.actionToken); return undefined;
    }
    return target && !isDeepStrictEqual(entry.target, target) ? undefined : entry;
  };
  return {
    mint(scope, target) {
      if (!input.current(scope)) throw new Error("Retired workbench scope.");
      for (const [token, entry] of entries)
        if (!input.current(entry.action.scope) || (!entry.claimed && input.now() >= entry.expires))
          entries.delete(token);
      const action = Object.freeze({ actionToken: randomUUID(), scope: Object.freeze({ ...scope }) });
      entries.set(action.actionToken, { action, target: structuredClone(target),
        expires: input.now() + 5_000, claimed: false });
      return action;
    },
    claim(action, target) {
      const entry = lookup(action, target);
      if (!entry || entry.claimed) return false;
      entry.claimed = true; return true;
    },
    isClaimed(action, target) { return lookup(action, target)?.claimed === true; },
    complete(action) {
      const entry = entries.get(action.actionToken);
      if (entry && sameScope(entry.action.scope, action.scope)) entries.delete(action.actionToken);
    },
    retire(scope) {
      for (const [token, entry] of entries)
        if (sameScope(entry.action.scope, scope)) entries.delete(token);
    },
  };
}
```

A claimed action survives the five-second *initial claim* deadline only for the existing bounded operation. The broker/coordinator retains its original attempt deadline and checks `isClaimed` at continuation; it never calls `claim` a second time. The adapter completes the action in `finally`, including failure; a new explicit click mints a new action and may retry retained recovery evidence without replaying the failed attempt. Navigation/window replacement first retires the old scope and invalidates authority, before opening a new workbench identity.

```ts
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createCoreActionLedger } from "./core-recovery.js";
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${n.toString().padStart(12, "0")}`;
const scope = { hostEpoch: id(1), workbenchInstance: id(2) };
const target = { kind: "device-disconnect" as const, sessionId: id(3) };
it("claims only the original target/scope once within five seconds", () => {
  let now = 0;
  const ledger = createCoreActionLedger({ now: () => now, current: () => true });
  const action = ledger.mint(scope, target);
  expect(ledger.claim({ ...action, scope: { ...scope, workbenchInstance: id(4) } }, target)).toBe(false);
  expect(ledger.claim(action, { ...target, sessionId: id(5) })).toBe(false);
  expect(ledger.claim(action, { kind: "device-current-stop", sessionId: id(3) })).toBe(false);
  now = 4_999; expect(ledger.claim(action, target)).toBe(true);
  expect(ledger.claim(action, target)).toBe(false);
  now = 5_001; expect(ledger.isClaimed(action, target)).toBe(true);
  ledger.complete(action); expect(ledger.isClaimed(action, target)).toBe(false);
  const expired = ledger.mint(scope, target); now += 5_000;
  expect(ledger.claim(expired, target)).toBe(false);
});
it("retires claimed actions with the window and uses fresh actions for retry", () => {
  let current = true;
  const ledger = createCoreActionLedger({ now: () => 0, current: () => current });
  const failed = ledger.mint(scope, target);
  expect(ledger.claim(failed, target)).toBe(true);
  ledger.complete(failed);
  const retry = ledger.mint(scope, target);
  expect(retry.actionToken).not.toBe(failed.actionToken);
  expect(ledger.claim(failed, target)).toBe(false);
  expect(ledger.claim(retry, target)).toBe(true);
  ledger.retire(scope); expect(ledger.isClaimed(retry, target)).toBe(false);
  current = false; expect(() => ledger.mint(scope, target)).toThrow("Retired");
});
```

```ts
import type { Permission } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Principal, ProfileWriterLock } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { CoreActionLedger } from "../plugins/core-recovery.js";
import type { AuthorityPort } from "./authority-port.js";
import type { JournalPort } from "./journal-port.js";
import { createDeviceBroker, type DeviceBrokerPort, type LegacyOperationPort,
  type DeviceRequirement, type DeviceOperationGate } from "./broker-port.js";
import type { BuiltinDeviceProvider, ProviderCatalogPort, DeviceConnectionPolicy } from "./provider.js";
import { attachBuiltinDeviceProvider } from "../plugins/builtin.js";
import type { PluginManager } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";

export interface DesktopFoundationOptions {
  profile: ProfileWriterLock;
  authority: AuthorityPort;
  journal: JournalPort;
  coreActions: CoreActionLedger;
  now: () => number;
  hasPermission: (principal: Principal, permission: Permission) => boolean;
  requirements: (owner: ResourceOwner) => readonly DeviceRequirement[] | null;
  connectionPolicy: () => DeviceConnectionPolicy;
  operationGate: DeviceOperationGate;
  providerFactory?: (catalog: ProviderCatalogPort) => BuiltinDeviceProvider;
}
export type DesktopFoundation = {
  broker: DeviceBrokerPort & LegacyOperationPort;
  attachProvider(manager: Pick<PluginManager, "state" | "onEvent">): void;
  dispose(): Promise<void>;
};
export async function createDesktopFoundation(input: DesktopFoundationOptions): Promise<DesktopFoundation> {
  input.profile.assertHeld();
  await input.journal.load();
  input.profile.assertHeld();
  const broker = createDeviceBroker({ profile: input.profile, authority: input.authority,
    journal: input.journal, coreActions: input.coreActions, now: input.now,
    hasPermission: input.hasPermission, requirements: input.requirements,
    connectionPolicy: input.connectionPolicy, operationGate: input.operationGate });
  let attached = false, disposed = false;
  let detach: (() => void) | undefined;
  let disposal: Promise<void> | undefined;
  return { broker,
    attachProvider(manager) {
      if (disposed || disposal) throw new Error("Foundation disposal has started.");
      if (attached) throw new Error("Provider attachment is one-shot.");
      attached = true;
      detach = attachBuiltinDeviceProvider(manager, broker,
        broker.providerCatalog("kobrixa.device-ev3"), input.providerFactory);
    },
    dispose() {
      if (disposed) return Promise.resolve();
      if (disposal) return disposal;
      const attempt = (async () => {
        input.profile.assertHeld();
        const disposition = await broker.resources.beginShutdown();
        if (!disposition.stopConfirmed || !disposition.journalCommitted)
          throw new CleanupBlocked(disposition, []);
        detach?.(); disposed = true;
      })();
      disposal = attempt;
      void attempt.catch(() => { disposal = undefined; });
      return attempt;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { Stage3RuntimePorts, Stage3HostAttachment, UiRuntimeAttachment } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { unavailableUi150, resourceFreePersistence150 } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { LifecycleCoordinator } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
import type { DesktopMainComposition, DesktopMainCompositionInput } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";
import { attachDeviceRpc } from "../device-broker/rpc-router.js";
export type { DesktopFoundationOptions, DesktopFoundation, DesktopMainComposition,
  DesktopMainCompositionInput } from "../device-broker/lifecycle-coordinator.js";

const lifecycles = new WeakMap<DesktopMainComposition, LifecycleCoordinator>();
export function desktopLifecycle(composition: DesktopMainComposition): LifecycleCoordinator {
  const coordinator = lifecycles.get(composition);
  if (!coordinator) throw new Error("Unknown desktop composition.");
  return coordinator;
}
export async function composeDesktopMain(input: DesktopMainCompositionInput): Promise<DesktopMainComposition> {
  input.foundationOptions.profile.assertHeld();
  const foundation = await input.createFoundation(input.foundationOptions);
  const broker = foundation.broker;
  const stage3: Stage3RuntimePorts = { device: broker.resources,
    persistence: resourceFreePersistence150(), ui: unavailableUi150() };
  let runtimeAttachment: UiRuntimeAttachment | undefined;
  const originalChannels = new Map<string, import("@kobrixa/plugin-runtime").Stage3ChannelContext>();
  const ownerKey = (owner: import("@kobrixa/plugin-protocol").ResourceOwner) => JSON.stringify([
    owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId, owner.generation, owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
  let plugins: PluginController | undefined;
  const runtime = (): UiRuntimeAttachment => {
    if (!runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Stage 3 runtime not attached.");
    return runtimeAttachment;
  };
  const coordinator = new LifecycleCoordinator({ ports: stage3,
    resources: broker.resources, sessions: broker.sessions, reservations: broker.reservations,
    persistence: stage3.persistence, now: input.foundationOptions.now,
    alive: owner => { const channel = originalChannels.get(ownerKey(owner)); return !!channel && !channel.peer.closed; },
    owners: () => runtime().owners(),
    dispatch: (owner, request, signal) => runtime().dispatchDrain(owner, request, signal),
    shutdown: async () => { if (plugins) await plugins.shutdown(); },
    legacyFlush: input.legacyFlush, report: input.report,
  });
  const stage3Host: Stage3HostAttachment = {
    hostEpoch: input.foundationOptions.profile.hostEpoch,
    principal: input.principal,
    hasPermission: (owner, permission) => input.foundationOptions.hasPermission(input.principal(owner), permission),
    requirements(owner) {
      const declarations = input.foundationOptions.requirements(owner);
      return declarations === null ? null : Object.freeze(declarations.map(value => Object.freeze({ ...value })));
    },
    bindChannel(context) {
      const principal = context.principal();
      const key = (owner: typeof context.owner) => JSON.stringify([owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId,
        owner.generation, owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
      if (principal.kind !== "plugin" || key(principal.owner) !== key(context.owner))
        throw new Error("Channel owner mismatch.");
      originalChannels.set(ownerKey(context.owner), context);
      const detach = attachDeviceRpc({ peer: context.peer, principal: context.principal, broker });
      return { async initialized(signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); },
        async ready(signal) { signal.throwIfAborted(); },
        dispose() { detach(); originalChannels.delete(ownerKey(context.owner)); } };
    },
    retireResources: (owner, reason) => coordinator.retire(owner, reason),
  };
  try {
    plugins = await startPlugins({ ...input.plugins, stage3, stage3Host,
      onStage3Runtime(attachment, providers) {
        if (runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Runtime already attached.");
        runtimeAttachment = attachment;
        foundation.attachProvider(providers);
      },
    });
    if (!runtimeAttachment) throw new Error("Missing runtime attachment.");
    let disposed = false;
    const composition: DesktopMainComposition = { foundation, plugins, stage3, stage3Host,
      async dispose() {
        if (disposed) return;
        await coordinator.close("close");
        await foundation.dispose();
        coordinator.dispose(); disposed = true;
      },
    };
    lifecycles.set(composition, coordinator);
    return composition;
  } catch (error) {
    try { await foundation.dispose(); coordinator.dispose(); }
    catch (cleanup) { input.report(cleanup); throw cleanup; }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { Principal } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { DeviceBrokerPort } from "../device-broker/broker-port.js";
import type { CoreActionLedger } from "./core-recovery.js";
export function trustedDeviceActions(broker: Pick<DeviceBrokerPort, "stopCurrentDevice">,
  coordinator: Pick<LifecycleCoordinator, "disconnect">, coreActions: CoreActionLedger) {
  return {
    async trustedCoreDisconnect(sessionId: string, principal: Principal): Promise<void> {
      if (principal.kind !== "core") throw new Error("Core workbench required.");
      const action = coreActions.mint({ hostEpoch: principal.hostEpoch,
        workbenchInstance: principal.workbenchInstance }, { kind: "device-disconnect", sessionId });
      try { await coordinator.disconnect(sessionId, action); }
      finally { coreActions.complete(action); }
    },
    async trustedCoreStop(sessionId: string, principal: Principal): Promise<void> {
      if (principal.kind !== "core") throw new Error("Core workbench required.");
      const action = coreActions.mint({ hostEpoch: principal.hostEpoch,
        workbenchInstance: principal.workbenchInstance }, { kind: "device-current-stop", sessionId });
      try {
        const result = await broker.stopCurrentDevice({ sessionId, action });
        if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message);
      } finally { coreActions.complete(action); }
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  expect(f.persistence.freeze).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  f.device.resolve(clean);
  await expect(retired).rejects.toThrow("disposition");
  expect(f.persistence.ownerLost).toHaveBeenCalledOnce(); expect(f.persistence.drain).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(f.coordinator.retire({ ...owner }, "crashed")).toBe(retired);
  f.coordinator.dispose();
});
it("F19 coalesces repeated Disconnect without another quiesce, grant or final handler", async () => {
  const f = fixture(); const first = f.coordinator.disconnect(id(3), action);
  expect(f.coordinator.disconnect(id(3), action)).toBe(first);
  expect(f.sessions.quiesce).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  f.storage.resolve(saved); f.device.resolve(clean); await first;
  expect(f.persistence.drain).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  expect(f.legacyFlush).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith("close");
  expect(f.sessions.disconnect).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
});
```
