```ts
import { mkdtemp, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createJournal } from "./journal.js";
import { createJournalFilesystem } from "./journal-filesystem.js";
import { AuthorityContexts } from "./authority-context.js";
import { createCoreActionLedger } from "../plugins/core-recovery.js";
import type { DesktopFoundationOptions } from "./lifecycle-coordinator.js";

import { PluginManager } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import { BUILTIN_PLUGIN_SOURCES } from "../plugins/builtin.js";
import type { ProviderCatalogPort } from "./provider.js";
async function providerComposition(safeMode = false, disabled = false, wrongId = false) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "kobrixa-d150-"));
  const now = () => performance.now();
  const profile = { hostEpoch: id(1), assertHeld: vi.fn() };
  const authority = new AuthorityContexts(profile.hostEpoch);
  const journal = createJournal(createJournalFilesystem(root), profile);
  const coreActions = createCoreActionLedger({ now, current: () => false });
  const catalogs: ProviderCatalogPort[] = [];
  const controls: FakeProviderControl[] = [];
  const foundation = await createDesktopFoundation({ profile, authority, journal, coreActions, now,
    hasPermission: () => false, requirements: () => null,
    operationGate: () => ({ ok: true, value: null }),
    connectionPolicy: () => ({ wifiConnectTimeoutMs: 10000, wifiHandshakeTimeoutMs: 5000,
      usbAutoReconnect: false, usbRetryInterval: 2000, usbRetryLimit: 3 }),
    providerFactory(catalog) {
      catalogs.push(catalog);
      const fake = createFakeDeviceProvider({ catalog, now }); controls.push(fake.control);
      if (wrongId) Object.defineProperty(fake.provider, "id", { value: "wrong.provider" });
      return fake.provider;
    },
  });
  const register = foundation.broker.registerProvider.bind(foundation.broker);
  const removals: Array<ReturnType<typeof vi.fn<() => void>>> = [];
  const registration = vi.spyOn(foundation.broker, "registerProvider").mockImplementation(provider => {
    const remove = vi.fn(register(provider)); removals.push(remove); return remove;
  });
  const manager = await PluginManager.create({ sources: BUILTIN_PLUGIN_SOURCES,
    store: { load: async () => ({ disabled: new Set(disabled ? ["builtin:kobrixa.device-ev3"] : []), legacyDisabledIds: new Set() }), save: async () => {} },
    safeMode, locale: "en", launcher: async () => { throw new Error("Provider-only source must not launch"); },
  });
  return { foundation, manager, catalogs, controls, registration, removals, profile,
    async cleanup() { await manager.shutdown(); await foundation.dispose(); await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); } };
}

it("BM-03 wrong provider ID is refused before registration", async () => {

    expect(() => f.foundation.attachProvider(f.manager)).toThrow("disposal");
```

Create `tests/desktop/device-broker-harness.mjs` with the following complete code. Matrix test names must include the literal ID (for example `F05 helper-arm authority changes`). This is an acceptance naming requirement for the already assigned owner tests, not permission for T9 to edit them. Missing named assertions fail the gate and return to that owner. Each row runs the real test file, rather than accepting a manually checked box.

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
const broker = "apps/desktop/src/main/device-broker/";
const provider = "apps/desktop/src/main/device-providers/ev3/";
const runtime = "packages/plugin-runtime/src/";
const protocol = "packages/plugin-protocol/src/";
export const matrix = Object.freeze({
  F01: [runtime + "registry.test.ts", broker + "registry.test.ts"],
  F02: [broker + "rpc-router.test.ts", broker + "intent.test.ts"],
  F03: [broker + "broker.test.ts", broker + "authority-context.test.ts"],
  F04: [broker + "operations.test.ts"],
  F05: [broker + "operations.test.ts", provider + "motion.test.ts", broker + "legacy-files.test.ts"],
  F06: [broker + "intent.test.ts", provider + "motion.test.ts"],
  F07: [broker + "sampler.test.ts", broker + "reservations.test.ts", broker + "operations.test.ts"],
  F08: [provider + "motion.test.ts"],
  F09: [broker + "fake-provider.test.ts", broker + "resource-participant.test.ts"],
  F10: [broker + "journal.test.ts", broker + "journal-filesystem.test.ts"],
  F11: [broker + "recovery-port.test.ts"],
  F12: [broker + "reservations.test.ts", broker + "sampler.test.ts"],
  F13: [broker + "rpc-router.test.ts", "packages/plugin-sdk-js/src/events.test.ts"],
  F14: [broker + "legacy-device.test.ts", broker + "legacy-files.test.ts", broker + "legacy-lab.test.ts"],
  F15: ["apps/desktop/src/main/device/file-batch.test.ts", broker + "legacy-files.test.ts"],
  F16: ["packages/plugin-sdk-js/src/devices.test.ts", protocol + "device-contract.test.ts"],
  F17: [broker + "lifecycle-coordinator.test.ts", runtime + "ui-lifecycle.test.ts"],
  F18: [protocol + "business-result.test.ts", protocol + "device-contract.test.ts"],
  F19: [broker + "reservations.test.ts", broker + "lifecycle-coordinator.test.ts"],
  F20: ["apps/desktop/src/main/plugins/profile-writer-lock.test.ts", runtime + "manager.test.ts"],
  F21: ["packages/device/src/io-boundary.test.ts", provider + "motion.test.ts"],
});

export function run(command, args, options = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command, args, {
      cwd: root, stdio: "inherit", ...options,
      env: { ...process.env, pnpm_config_pm_on_fail: "ignore",
        pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run: "false", ...options.env },
    });
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      child.kill("SIGKILL");
      reject(new Error(`${command} exceeded the harness deadline`));
    }, options.timeoutMs ?? 180_000);
    child.once("error", (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); });
    child.once("exit", (code, signal) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (code !== 0) reject(new Error(`${command}: exit ${code}, signal ${signal}`));
      else resolve({ code, signal });
    });
  });
}

export function assertMatrix(report) {
  assert.equal(report.cases.length, Object.keys(matrix).length);
  for (const id of Object.keys(matrix)) {
    const matches = report.cases.filter((entry) => entry.id === id);
    assert.equal(matches.length, 1, `${id}: missing/duplicate row`);
    assert.equal(matches[0].status, "passed", `${id}: incomplete evidence`);
    assert.ok(matches[0].assertions > 0, `${id}: zero assertions`);
  }
}

export async function runOwnedMatrix() {
  const temporary = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "kobrixa-device-matrix-"));
  const output = path.join(temporary, "vitest.json");
  try {
    await run(process.platform === "win32" ? "pnpm.cmd" : "pnpm", ["exec", "vitest", "run",
      ...new Set(Object.values(matrix).flat()), "--reporter=json", `--outputFile=${output}`]);
    const result = JSON.parse(await readFile(output, "utf8"));
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    const cases = Object.entries(matrix).map(([id, files]) => {
      let assertions = 0;
      for (const file of files) {
        const suite = result.testResults.find((entry) => entry.name.replaceAll("\\", "/").endsWith(file));
        assert.ok(suite, `${id}: ${file} did not execute`);
        const named = suite.assertionResults.filter((entry) => new RegExp(`\\b${id}\\b`).test(entry.fullName));
        assert.ok(named.length > 0, `${id}: ${file} needs its assigned negative-case label`);
        for (const entry of named) assert.equal(entry.status, "passed", `${id}: ${entry.fullName}`);
        assertions += named.length;
      }
      return { id, status: "passed", assertions };
    });
    return { cases };
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

export const percentile = (values, fraction) => {
  assert.ok(values.length > 0);
  assert.ok(values.every((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0));
  return [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.ceil(fraction * values.length) - 1];
};
export function assertParity(report) {
  const expected = ["negotiate", "list", "session", "read", "subscribe", "mode-query",
    "mode-set", "reserve", "recording-read", "release", "prepare", "start", "stop", "query", "unsubscribe"];
  assert.equal(report.transports.length, 2);
  for (const [language, transport] of [["js", "electron-message-port"], ["python", "content-length"]]) {
    const result = report.transports.find((entry) => entry.language === language);
    assert.ok(result);
    assert.equal(result.transport, transport);
    assert.equal(result.ok, true);
    assert.deepEqual(result.scenario, expected);
  }
}
export function assertLoad(report) {
  assert.ok(report.durationMs >= 600_000);
  assert.deepEqual(report.scale, { channels: 38, actuators: 4, providers: 8,
    candidatesPerProvider: 32, candidatesGlobal: 64, subscriptions: 32, queueBytes: 262_144, journalEntries: 64 });
  assert.ok(report.stopDispatchMs.length >= 100);
  assert.ok(percentile(report.stopDispatchMs, 0.95) <= 50, "stop dispatch p95 exceeds 50 ms");
  for (const phase of ["transport", "readback", "journal"]) percentile(report.measurements[phase], 0.95);
  for (const key of ["commit", "artifact", "os", "arch", "cpu", "ramBytes", "filesystem", "node", "electron", "warmCold", "memoryMethod"])
    assert.ok(report.environment[key], `Missing environment.${key}`);
  assert.match(report.environment.commit, /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
  assert.ok(report.retainedHeap.length >= 11);
  assert.ok(report.retainedHeap.at(-1).elapsedMs >= 600_000);
  // Local leak detector, not a new product budget. Last-half growth must fit the
  // first-half measured oscillation; monotonically growing retention fails.
  const values = report.retainedHeap.map((entry) => entry.bytes);
  assert.ok(values.every((value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0));
  const first = values.slice(1, 6), last = values.slice(-5);
  const noise = Math.max(...first) - Math.min(...first);
  assert.ok(Math.max(...last) <= Math.max(...first) + noise, "retained heap keeps growing");
}
```

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

async function sources(directory) {
  const result = [];
  for (const entry of await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const file = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) result.push(...await sources(file));
    else if (/\.(?:ts|tsx|mjs|py)$/.test(entry.name) && !/\.test\./.test(entry.name)) result.push(file);

}
```

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { definePlugin, runPlugin } from "@kobrixa/plugin-sdk";

const fixture = JSON.parse(readFileSync("fixture.json", "utf8")) as {
  contextRef: string;
  motionScopeRef: string;
  negotiateOnly?: boolean;
  expectedSatisfied?: boolean;
};
function value<T>(result: { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: { code: string; message: string } }): T {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`${result.error.code}: ${result.error.message}`);
  return result.value;
}
void runPlugin(definePlugin({
  activate(context) {
    context.commands.register("kobrixa-fixture.devices.probe", async () => {
      const scenario: string[] = [];
      const devices = context.devices;
      const negotiated = value(await devices.negotiate({}));
      if (negotiated.devicesContractVersion !== 1) throw new Error("Wrong contract version");
      if (fixture.negotiateOnly) {
        if (negotiated.requirementsSatisfied !== fixture.expectedSatisfied) throw new Error("Requirements mismatch");
        await context.ui.showMessage(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, negotiated }));
        return;
      }
      scenario.push("negotiate");
      const listed = value(await devices.list({}));
      const sessionId = listed.sessions[0]?.sessionId;
      if (!sessionId) throw new Error("Trusted host did not connect its fixture");
      scenario.push("list");
      const { sources } = value(await devices.session({ sessionId }));
      scenario.push("session");
      const channelIds = sources.channels.slice(0, 4).map((channel) => channel.channelId);
      value(await devices.read({ sessionId, channelIds, freshness: "fresh" }));
      scenario.push("read");
      const subscription = await devices.subscribe({ topic: "telemetry", sessionId, channelIds, intervalMs: 500 }, () => {});
      scenario.push("subscribe");
      try {
        const portId = sources.channels[0]!.portId!;
        const modes = value(await devices.inputModes.query({ sessionId, portId, expectedSourceRevision: sources.sourceRevision }));
        scenario.push("mode-query");
        const changed = value(await devices.inputModes.set({ sessionId, portId,
          expectedSourceRevision: modes.sourceRevision, modeId: modes.modes[0]!.modeId, contextRef: fixture.contextRef }));
        scenario.push("mode-set");
        const freshChannels = changed.sources.channels.slice(0, 4).map((channel) => channel.channelId);
        const reserved = value(await devices.recording.reserve({ sessionId, channelIds: freshChannels,
          expectedSourceRevision: changed.sources.sourceRevision }));
        scenario.push("reserve");
        value(await devices.recording.read({ reservationId: reserved.reservation.reservationId, afterSequence: 0, limit: 64 }));
        scenario.push("recording-read");
        value(await devices.recording.release({ reservationId: reserved.reservation.reservationId }));
        scenario.push("release");
        const prepared = value(await devices.motion.prepare({ sessionId, contextRef: fixture.contextRef,
          motionScopeRef: fixture.motionScopeRef,
          motion: { mode: "timed", actuatorId: changed.sources.actuators[0]!.actuatorId,
            power: 1, direction: 1, brake: false, durationMs: 100 } }));
        const operationId = prepared.operation.operationId;
        scenario.push("prepare");
        value(await devices.motion.start({ operationId }));
        scenario.push("start");
        value(await devices.motion.stop({ operationId, stopMode: "brake" }));
        scenario.push("stop");
        const deadline = performance.now() + 20_000;
        let operation = value(await devices.motion.query({ operationId })).operation;
        while (["preparing", "running", "stopping"].includes(operation.phase)) {
          if (performance.now() >= deadline) throw new Error("Fixture stop did not settle");
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
          operation = value(await devices.motion.query({ operationId })).operation;
        }
        if (operation.stopConfirmation !== "confirmed" && operation.dispatch !== "not-sent")
          throw new Error("Fixture has unresolved stop outcome");
        scenario.push("query");
      } finally {
        await subscription.dispose();
        await subscription.dispose();
      }
      scenario.push("unsubscribe");
      await context.ui.showMessage(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, scenario }));
    });
  },
}));
```

```ts
  { name: "absent", requires: [], satisfied: true },
  { name: "required-supported", requires: [{ capability: "telemetry.v1", required: true }], satisfied: true },
  { name: "optional-supported", requires: [{ capability: "telemetry.v1", required: false }], satisfied: true },

  }
}
```

```js
    env: { PYTHONPATH: path.join(root, "sdks/python") }, timeoutMs: 150_000,
  });
  const report = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(temporary, "transport-result.json"), "utf8"));
  assertParity(report);
  const marker = path.join(temporary, "stall-entered.json");
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [path.join(temporary, "stall.cjs"), marker], { stdio: "ignore" });
  const exited = new Promise((resolve, reject) => { child.once("error", reject); child.once("exit", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal })); });
  const limit = performance.now() + 5_000;
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const value = await readFile(marker, "utf8").catch(() => null);
      if (value) { assert.equal(JSON.parse(value).pid, child.pid); break; }
      if (performance.now() >= limit) throw new Error("Stall fixture failed to enter");
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
    }
  } finally { child.kill("SIGKILL"); }
  await Promise.race([exited, new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Stall child survived kill")), 5_000))]);
  assert.throws(() => process.kill(child.pid, 0), { code: "ESRCH" });
  report.commit = execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { cwd: root, encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
  report.stall = "child-entered-and-killed";
  // Controller keeps this artifact with the acceptance report before deleting the temp directory.
  console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  passed = true;
} finally {
  if (passed) await rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
  else console.error(`Device transport artifacts: ${temporary}`);
}
```

The stall test establishes the external watchdog boundary. It does not claim the main thread can preempt a blocking native provider. F09's broker test must separately prove quarantine, retained ownership and a durable pending marker before the stalled provider is invoked.

- [ ] **Step 11: Add and run the ten-minute bounded workload.**

Append the following implementation to `tests/desktop/device-broker-main.ts` before its `app.whenReady` entrypoint. Add `createMemoryChannelPair` to the existing protocol imports, add `DeviceBrokerPort` as a type import from `broker-port.ts`, and import `cpus`, `totalmem`, `platform`, `arch` from `node:os` plus `execFileSync` from `node:child_process`. This workload uses the actual broker/router with a synthetic provider and in-memory journal. Its transport/readback/journal measurements are labelled synthetic; the earlier two-process test separately proves real SDK transports. Stop dispatch uses the canonical fake control trace timestamp for the stop exchange, measured from the client's request instant (a conservative bound on broker-to-provider dispatch), not from the stop acknowledgement. It measures configured queue pressure and retained memory, while F13 owns the exact internal 256-KiB high-water assertion.

```ts
async function runMaximumLoad(broker: DeviceBrokerPort): Promise<object> {
  const gc = (globalThis as typeof globalThis & { gc?: () => void }).gc;
  if (!gc) throw new Error("Load run requires Electron --js-flags=--expose-gc");
  const now = () => performance.now();
  const pause = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "dev:0123456789abcdef", pluginId: "kobrixa-fixture.devices",
    generation: 3, hostEpoch, processEpoch: randomUUID() };
  const principal: Principal = { kind: "plugin", owner, authorityContext: { ref, epoch } };
  admitted.set(owner, Object.freeze([]));
  const removeProviders = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => broker.registerProvider(fakeProvider(broker, `kobrixa.fixture${i + 2}`)));
  const [hostChannel, clientChannel] = createMemoryChannelPair();
  const hostPeer = new RpcPeer(hostChannel), clientPeer = new RpcPeer(clientChannel);
  const detach = attachDeviceRpc({ peer: hostPeer, principal: () => principal, broker });
  let deliveredBytes = 0;
  clientPeer.onNotification("events/deliver", (event) => {
    deliveredBytes += Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(event), "utf8");
    // Intentionally no ack: exercise bounded host queue/coalescing/overflow.
  });
  const stopDispatchMs: number[] = [];
  const transport: number[] = [], readback: number[] = [], journalTimes = journalMeasurements;
  journalTimes.length = 0;
  const retainedHeap: { elapsedMs: number; bytes: number }[] = [];
  let heartbeat: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
  let subscriptions: string[] = [];
  const measured = async <T>(work: () => Promise<T>, samples: number[]) => {
    const started = now();
    try { return await work(); } finally { if (samples.length === 256) samples.shift(); samples.push(now() - started); }
  };
  try {
    successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/negotiate", {}));
    const list = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/list", {}));
    assert.equal(list.providers.length, 8);
    const first = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/discover", { providerId: "kobrixa.device-ev3" }));
    const second = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/discover", { providerId: "kobrixa.fixture2" }));
    assert.equal(first.candidates.length, 32); assert.equal(second.candidates.length, 32);
    const overflow = await clientPeer.request("devices/discover", { providerId: "kobrixa.fixture3" });
    assert.equal(overflow.ok, false);
    if (!overflow.ok) assert.equal(overflow.error.code, "PLUGIN_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT");
    const session = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/connect", {
      target: { kind: "candidate", candidateId: first.candidates[0]!.candidateId } })).session;
    const sources = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/session", { sessionId: session.sessionId })).sources;
    assert.equal(sources.channels.length, 38); assert.equal(sources.actuators.length, 4);
    // Startup loaded 64 resolved historical entries through the injected journal port.
    // Unresolved/full and replacement-space faults use F10's real filesystem adapter.
    assert.equal(document.entries.length, 64);
    const scope = broker.intent.bindMotionScope({ owner, contextRef: ref, panelInstance: randomUUID(),
      uiResourceGeneration: 0, workbenchInstance });
    let pulse = 1;
    broker.intent.pulsePanel(scope, pulse++);
    heartbeat = setInterval(() => broker.intent.pulsePanel(scope, pulse++), 100);
    const refill = async () => {
      for (const subscriptionId of subscriptions) {
        const removed = await clientPeer.request("events/unsubscribe", { subscriptionId });
        if (!removed.ok) assert.equal(removed.error.code, "PLUGIN_E_STALE_RESOURCE");
      }
      subscriptions = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < 32; index++) {
        const result = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/subscribe", { topic: "telemetry",
          sessionId: session.sessionId, channelIds: sources.channels.map((channel) => channel.channelId), intervalMs: 500 }));
        subscriptions.push(result.subscriptionId);
      }
      const excess = await clientPeer.request("devices/subscribe", { topic: "catalog" });
      assert.equal(excess.ok, false);
      if (!excess.ok) assert.equal(excess.error.code, "PLUGIN_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT");
    };
    await refill();
    // Five-second warmup is reported separately, not deducted from the ten-minute sample.
    await pause(5_000);
    const started = now();
    let sampleAt = started, refreshAt = started + 30_000;
    while (now() - started < 600_000) {
      if (now() >= sampleAt) { gc(); retainedHeap.push({ elapsedMs: now() - started, bytes: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed }); sampleAt += 60_000; }
      if (now() >= refreshAt) { await refill(); refreshAt += 30_000; }
      successful(await measured(() => clientPeer.request("devices/read", { sessionId: session.sessionId,
        channelIds: sources.channels.map((channel) => channel.channelId), freshness: "fresh" }), transport));
      const prepared = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/motion/prepare", { sessionId: session.sessionId,
        contextRef: ref, motionScopeRef: scope, motion: { actuatorId: sources.actuators[0]!.actuatorId,
          mode: "timed", power: 1, direction: 1, brake: true, durationMs: 100 } }));
      const operationId = prepared.operation.operationId;
      successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/motion/start", { operationId }));
      await pause(20);
      stopAdmissionTimes.set(operationId, now());
      successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/motion/stop", { operationId, stopMode: "brake" }));
      await measured(async () => {
        const deadline = now() + 20_000;
        for (;;) {
          const { operation } = successful(await clientPeer.request("devices/motion/query", { operationId }));
          if (!["preparing", "running", "stopping"].includes(operation.phase)) {
            assert.ok(operation.stopConfirmation === "confirmed" || operation.dispatch === "not-sent");
            break;
          }
          if (now() >= deadline) throw new Error("Load stop disposition exceeded original bound");
          await pause(10);
        }
      }, readback);
      const dispatched = controls.get("kobrixa.device-ev3")!.trace()
        .find((entry) => entry.operationId === operationId && entry.step === "stop" && entry.dispatch !== "not-sent");
      assert.ok(dispatched, "Missing real stop dispatch trace");
      stopDispatchMs.push(dispatched.time - stopAdmissionTimes.get(operationId)!);
      stopAdmissionTimes.delete(operationId);
      await pause(500);
    }
    gc(); retainedHeap.push({ elapsedMs: now() - started, bytes: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed });
    assert.ok(deliveredBytes > 262_144, "Workload never generated one queue-budget worth of traffic");
    return { durationMs: now() - started, retainedHeap, stopDispatchMs,
      scale: { channels: 38, actuators: 4, providers: 8, candidatesPerProvider: 32, candidatesGlobal: 64,
        subscriptions: 32, queueBytes: 262_144, journalEntries: 64 },
      measurements: { transport, readback, journal: journalTimes },
      environment: { commit: execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim(),
        artifact: "source-bundled synthetic-provider load", os: platform(), arch: arch(), cpu: cpus()[0]?.model ?? "unknown",
        ramBytes: totalmem(), filesystem: "in-memory journal; no durability claim", node: process.version,
        electron: process.versions.electron, warmCold: "5s warmup then 600s measurement",
        memoryMethod: "forced GC retained heap, 60s samples; latency arrays retain last 256 observations" },
      traffic: { deliveredBytes, acknowledgement: "withheld", queueBudgetAssertion: "F13 owner test" } };
  } finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeat);
    for (const subscriptionId of subscriptions) await clientPeer.request("events/unsubscribe", { subscriptionId }).catch(() => undefined);
    admitted.delete(owner);
    await broker.resources.retire(owner, "disabled").settled;
    detach(); hostPeer.close(); clientPeer.close();
    for (const remove of removeProviders) remove();
    stopAdmissionTimes.clear();
  }
}
```

Create `docs/en/plugin-devices.md` with this complete content:

```markdown
# Device plugins (API 1.5.0)

Device consumers request `devices.read`, `devices.connect` and/or `devices.control` in their manifest. A permission grants eligibility, not a permanent lease. Negotiate after initialize, inspect provider/capability availability, and check every business result. An unavailable provider must remain unavailable until the user enables it.

Only the host allowlist can register `kobrixa.device-ev3`. A development plugin declaring `contributes.deviceProviders` is invalid even if the value is an empty array or null. `devices.provide` is not a permission. Plugins execute trusted local code; this API is a safety and compatibility boundary, not a hostile-code sandbox.

Use `context.devices` in JavaScript and `ctx.devices` in Python. Method names are the same except `inputModes` becomes `input_modes`. Wire object keys remain camelCase. Both SDKs return `{ok:true,value}` or `{ok:false,error:{code,message,detail?}}`; transport failures remain separate. See the two executable consumers in `tests/desktop/fixtures/device-broker/` for the same complete scenario.

The read path is negotiate → list → session → read/subscribe. `devices/context` returns only a host-bound context reference and its restricted snapshot. No default binding means unbound, not local authority. `devices.connect` accepts a host candidate or a canonical IP literal, never a hostname, credentials or native transport path. Read, browse, download and stopping one's own operation remain available without holder status, subject to source/session permissions.

Motion requires a host-issued visible panel scope, current authority and `devices.control`; jog additionally requires a real gesture. A consumer must not synthesize a scope, heartbeat or gesture. API 1.5 transport fixtures receive references from the trusted test host. General declarative UI binding arrives in 1.6. A missing UI scope is an explicit unavailable result.

Prepare performs no device I/O. Start consumes its reference once within 5 seconds. Preserve the operation ID before start; a timeout or lost reply does not justify another start. Query the original ID and request stop. Forced stop preserves brake even when the original motion requested coast. A stop acknowledgement records intent; only subsequent readback confirms stopping. Unconfirmed stop remains visible in core recovery after the feature disappears.

Query/control waits are 5 seconds, reads 15 seconds, connections 65 seconds in the SDK. Provider exchanges retain motor 2 seconds, ordinary 5 seconds and file transfer 10 seconds, capped by the original deadline. Stop/readback has 15 seconds including the in-flight exchange, followed by at most 5 seconds for journal disposition. Neither cancellation nor retry extends these clocks.

All monitor, battery and recorder demands share one session sampler. Polls wait 500 ms after completion, or 30 seconds when only battery remains. Recording reserves one to four stable channels; source changes end it. Frames may contain explicit gaps. Subscription queues and recording buffers are bounded: never assume an offline consumer can recover unlimited history. JS subscriptions expose `id`, `snapshot`, `lastSequence` and `dispose()`; Python subscriptions expose those fields and `close()`. SDK acknowledgements occur after validation and bounded enqueue, not after arbitrary user callbacks.

A reservation's first end fixes its final-read grant and deadline. Provider loss, suspend or core Disconnect does not retire a healthy consumer generation. Core Disconnect stops, saves and then disconnects, or displays a blocker. Wake never resumes motion or recording automatically. New settings/storage APIs are unavailable before 1.7; legacy Lab storage remains protected by its existing close/update/save guards.

Remote file confirmation expires after 120 seconds idle. Only an explicit user confirmation renews it, with an absolute 600-second lifetime. A late native dialog cannot execute an expired plan. Cancellation or lost authority stops subsequent chunks and entries but cannot roll back writes already sent.

The durable journal records uncertainty before risky motion/program dispatch. Full, corrupt or unwritable journals prevent new risk. Reconnecting to the same IP is not physical identity proof. Core recovery remains accessible with every optional feature disabled and in safe mode.

Automated synthetic-provider tests, actual Electron/Python transport tests, installed artifacts and physical USB/Wi-Fi evidence are distinct acceptance rows. This foundation does not certify motor UI migration (3C), Lab storage/charts migration (3D), stage-2 V01–V04 or final Stage 3 closeout (3E).
```

```markdown
# 設備插件（API 1.5.0）

consumer 在 manifest 要求 `devices.read`、`devices.connect`、`devices.control`。permission 只是受理資格，不是永久 lease。initialize 完成後才 negotiate，檢查 provider／capability availability，並檢查每個 business result。provider 停用時不可自動啟用。

只有 host allowlist 可註冊 `kobrixa.device-ev3`。development source 只要有 `contributes.deviceProviders`，即使為空陣列或 null 也 invalid；沒有 `devices.provide` permission。插件是使用者信任的本機程式；此 API 提供安全仲裁與相容性邊界，不是敵意程式碼的 sandbox。

JavaScript 使用 `context.devices`，Python 使用 `ctx.devices`；只有 `inputModes` 改名為 `input_modes`，wire keys 保留 camelCase。兩者回傳 `{ok:true,value}` 或 `{ok:false,error:{code,message,detail?}}`，transport failure 另計。完整對照案例位於 `tests/desktop/fixtures/device-broker/` 的兩個 consumer。

讀取流程為 negotiate → list → session → read/subscribe。`devices/context` 只回 host 綁定的 reference 與受限 snapshot；沒有綁定就是 unbound，不視為 local authority。connect 只接受 host candidate 或 canonical IP literal，不接受 hostname、credentials 或 native transport path。讀取、瀏覽、下載與停止自己的操作不要求 holder，但仍檢查 source／session 與 permission。

motion 需要 host 發給可見 panel 的 scope、目前 authority 與 `devices.control`；jog 還需要真實 gesture。consumer 不得自行建立 scope、heartbeat 或 gesture。1.5 transport fixture 的 reference 由可信 test host 提供；通用宣告 UI binding 在 1.6 交付。沒有 UI scope 必須明確回 unavailable。

prepare 不做設備 I/O。start 在 5 秒內一次消耗 reference。送 start 前保存 operation ID；timeout／reply 遺失不能重送 start，應 query／stop 原 ID。強制停止的 brake 不會被原本 coast 設定覆寫。stop acknowledgement 只表示已登記停止意圖；readback 才能證實停止。未確認的停止在功能消失後仍保留於核心復原。

SDK query／control 為 5 秒、read 為 15 秒、connection 為 65 秒。provider exchange 保留 motor 2 秒、一般 5 秒、file transfer 10 秒，並受原 deadline 限制。stop/readback 的 15 秒包含已送 exchange 的等待，之後 journal disposition 最多另 5 秒。取消與重試不得延長期限。

monitor、battery、recorder 共用同一 session sampler；完成一次 read 後等 500 ms，僅 battery demand 時等 30 秒。recording 保留一至四個固定 channels，source change 即結束。frames 可含明確 gap；subscription queue 與 recording ring 有界，不能假定離線期間無限保存。JS subscription 有 `id`、`snapshot`、`lastSequence`、`dispose()`；Python 同欄位加 `close()`。SDK 在驗證與有界 enqueue 後 ack，不等待任意 consumer callback。

reservation 第一次 end 固定 final-read grant 與 deadline。provider loss、suspend、core Disconnect 不 retire 健康 consumer generation。使用者一次 Disconnect 先停止、保存，再斷線；失敗顯示 blocker。wake 不自動續作。新 settings/storage API 在 1.7 前 unavailable；legacy Lab 原有 close/update/save 保護持續有效。

remote-files confirmation 閒置 120 秒到期，只有明確使用者確認可續租，總 lifetime 最多 600 秒。native dialog 晚回覆不可執行舊 plan。取消或失權阻止後續 chunks／entries，但不能假裝已送寫入能 rollback。

journal 在風險 motion/program dispatch 前持久記錄；full、corrupt、unwritable 時拒絕新風險。同 IP 不代表同一實體設備。所有 optional features 停用或 safe mode 時仍可使用 core recovery。

synthetic provider、實際 Electron/Python transport、installed artifact、真實 USB/Wi-Fi 分列驗收。本基礎不代簽 3C motor UI、3D Lab storage/charts、stage-2 V01–V04 或 3E 最終 closeout。
```

```ts
interface Stage3RuntimePorts {
  device: DeviceResourceParticipant;
  persistence: PersistenceParticipant;
  ui: UiCatalogPort;
}
type Stage3BuiltinSource = {
  kind: "builtin";
  manifest: unknown;
  resources: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  policy: BuiltinPolicy;
  launch?: BuiltinLaunchDescriptor;
};
interface DeviceResourceParticipant {
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner, reason: RetirementReason): {
    drain: DeviceDrainGrant | null;
    settled: Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  };
  retireProvider(providerId: string, providerGeneration: Counter): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
  beginShutdown(): Promise<DeviceDisposition>;
}
interface PersistenceParticipant {
  endReservation(event: ReservationEnded, deadline: number): DrainOffer | null;
  freeze(owner: PersistenceOwner, reason: DrainReason, deadline: number, deviceDrain?: DeviceDrainGrant): DrainOffer;
  drain(offer: DrainOffer, dispatch: DrainDispatcher): Promise<DrainReport>;
  ownerLost(owner: PersistenceOwner): Promise<DrainReport>;
  recoverySnapshot(): PersistenceRecoverySnapshot;
  retry(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
  discard(recovery: Handle, action: CoreActionReference): Promise<DrainReport>;
}
interface UiCatalogPort {
  catalog(input: { cursor?: Handle }): Promise<Result<UiCatalogPage>>;
  resource(input: Parameters<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>[0]): ReturnType<PluginUiBridge["resource"]>;
  retire(owner: ResourceOwner): void;
  onEvent(listener: (event: UiBridgeEvent) => void): () => void;
}
```

```ts
import type { ResourceOwner } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { Stage3RuntimePorts } from "./ui-lifecycle.js";

const owner: ResourceOwner = { sourceKey: "dev:0123456789abcdef", pluginId: "acme.probe", generation: 2,
  hostEpoch: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", processEpoch: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" };

it("F17 retire/freeze is synchronous; teardown waits for device disposition", async () => {
  const order: string[] = [];
  let finish!: (value: { stopConfirmed: boolean; faultIds: string[]; journalCommitted: boolean }) => void;
  const persistence = resourceFreePersistence150();
  const original = persistence.freeze;
  const freeze = vi.spyOn(persistence, "freeze").mockImplementation((...args) => {
    order.push("freeze"); return original(...args);
  });
  const ports: Stage3RuntimePorts = {

      retireProvider: vi.fn(), beginShutdown: vi.fn() },
    persistence,
    ui: { retire() { order.push("ui"); }, catalog: vi.fn(), resource: vi.fn(), onEvent: () => () => {} },
  };

  await Promise.resolve();
  expect(settled).toBe(false);
  expect(retireStage3Owner(ports, { ...owner }, "shutdown", () => 900, async () => { throw new Error("No drain RPC at P150"); })).toBe(result);
  finish({ stopConfirmed: true, faultIds: [], journalCommitted: true });

  expect(freeze).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { ResourceOwner as RetirementOwner150 } from "@kobrixa/plugin-protocol";
import type { DeviceDisposition as DeviceDisposition150, RetirementReason as RetirementReason150 } from "./device-resources.js";
import type { DrainDispatcher as DrainDispatcher150, DrainOffer as DrainOffer150, DrainReport as DrainReport150, PersistenceParticipant as PersistenceParticipant150 } from "./persistence-participant.js";

export type RetirementDisposition = { device: DeviceDisposition150; persistence: DrainReport150 };
const retirementResults = new WeakMap<Stage3RuntimePorts, Map<string, Promise<RetirementDisposition>>>();
const deviceRetirementReason: Record<OwnerRetirement, RetirementReason150> = {
  disable: "disabled", reload: "reload", remove: "disabled", crashed: "crashed",
  "renderer-crash": "renderer-lost", "window-destroyed": "renderer-lost",
  shutdown: "shutdown", update: "shutdown", "safe-mode": "safe-mode",
};
export function retireStage3Owner(
  ports: Stage3RuntimePorts, owner: RetirementOwner150,
  reason: OwnerRetirement, now: () => number, dispatch: DrainDispatcher150,
  deadlineMonotonicMs?: number,
): Promise<RetirementDisposition> {
  let completed = retirementResults.get(ports);
  if (!completed) { completed = new Map(); retirementResults.set(ports, completed); }
  const key = JSON.stringify([owner.sourceKey, owner.pluginId, owner.generation, owner.hostEpoch, owner.processEpoch]);
  const existing = completed.get(key); if (existing) return existing;
  let resolve!: (value: RetirementDisposition) => void;
  let reject!: (error: unknown) => void;
  const receipt = new Promise<RetirementDisposition>((yes, no) => { resolve = yes; reject = no; });
  // Publish before fencing: reentrant reservation notifications join this receipt.
  completed.set(key, receipt);
  try {
    const t0 = now();
    const device = ports.device.retire(owner, deviceRetirementReason[reason]);
    ports.ui.retire(owner);
    const deadline = Math.min(t0 + 10_000, deadlineMonotonicMs ?? Infinity,
      device.drain?.expiresMonotonicMs ?? Infinity);
    const offer = reason === "crashed" ? null : device.drain === null
      ? ports.persistence.freeze(owner, reason, deadline)
      : ports.persistence.freeze(owner, reason, deadline, device.drain);
    const storage = Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      if (!offer) return ports.persistence.ownerLost(owner);
      // freeze coalesces any end offer; never extend its original deadline.
      const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.min(deadline, offer.deadlineMonotonicMs) - now());
      const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(remaining);
      return ports.persistence.drain(offer, (original, request, callerSignal) =>
        dispatch(original, request, AbortSignal.any([callerSignal, signal])));
    });
    void Promise.all([device.settled, storage]).then(([device, persistence]) =>
      resolve({ device, persistence }), reject);
  } catch (error) { reject(error); }
  // Keep receipts for this ports lifetime: unresolved evidence and retired generations
  // are never re-admitted by an eviction policy.
  return receipt;
}

export function unavailableUi150(): Stage3RuntimePorts["ui"] {
  const unavailable = { ok: false as const, error: { code: "PLUGIN_E_DISABLED" as const,
    message: "Declarative UI is unavailable before API 1.6.0." } };
  return {
    async catalog() { return unavailable; },
    async resource() { return unavailable; },
    retire() {},
    onEvent() { return () => {}; },
  };
}

export function resourceFreePersistence150(): PersistenceParticipant150 {
  const offers = new WeakSet<DrainOffer150>();
  const empty = (): DrainReport150 => ({ state: "saved", blocker: false, pendingSettings: false, records: [], errors: [] });
  return {
    endReservation() { return null; },
    freeze(owner, reason, deadline) {
      const offer: DrainOffer150 = Object.freeze({ owner, reason, deadlineMonotonicMs: deadline, token: randomUUID(),
        checkpoints: [], writes: [], acceptedTickets: [] });
      offers.add(offer);
      return offer;
    },
    async drain(offer) {
      if (!offers.has(offer) || offer.checkpoints.length || offer.writes.length || offer.acceptedTickets.length)
        throw new Error("The API 1.5 resource-free adapter cannot save storage work.");
      return empty();
    },
    async ownerLost() { return empty(); },
    recoverySnapshot() { return { revision: 0, items: [] }; },
    async retry() { throw new Error("No API 1.5 persistence recovery action exists."); },
    async discard() { throw new Error("No API 1.5 persistence recovery action exists."); },
  };
}
```

```ts
async activateInitialized(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Stage3ChannelContext> {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  const started = this.#ensureStarted();
  const barrier = this.#initialized;
  void started.catch((error) => barrier.reject(error));
  const context = await barrier.promise;
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  if (this.#peer !== context.peer || this.#stopping) throw this.#stopError("Retired initialized channel");
  return context;
}
async ready(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  await this.#ensureStarted();
  signal.throwIfAborted();
}
```

```ts
readonly #admittedOwners = new Map<ResourceOwner, readonly DeviceRequirement[]>();

requirements(owner: ResourceOwner): readonly DeviceRequirement[] | null {
  for (const [admitted, requirements] of this.#admittedOwners) {
    if (admitted.sourceKey !== owner.sourceKey || admitted.pluginId !== owner.pluginId ||
        admitted.generation !== owner.generation || admitted.hostEpoch !== owner.hostEpoch ||
        admitted.processEpoch !== owner.processEpoch) continue;
    const entry = this.#entryOf(admitted.sourceKey);
    if (!entry || entry.generation !== admitted.generation || entry.plugin.status !== "enabled") return null;
    return requirements;
  }
  return null;
}
```

Remove owners synchronously before calling the host retirement callback. Use the same full-tuple equality for all lifecycle admission and event dispatch. Stage3HostAttachment.hasPermission likewise checks the admitted manifest permissions and the live workbench binding.

Implement the single cached P150 attachment in the manager. Import `Stage3ChannelContext` from `ui-lifecycle.ts`. The UI methods are explicitly inert only until P160; device identity and barriers are real now. No storage drain is published before P170.

```ts
readonly #stage3Channels = new Map<ResourceOwner, Stage3ChannelContext>();
#stage3Attachment: UiRuntimeAttachment | undefined;

stage3Runtime(): UiRuntimeAttachment {
  if (!this.options.stage3 || !this.options.stage3Host) throw new Error("Stage 3 runtime is not attached");
  const channel = (owner: ResourceOwner) => {
    if (this.requirements(owner) === null) return undefined;
    return [...this.#stage3Channels.values()].find(({ owner: current }) =>
      current.sourceKey === owner.sourceKey && current.pluginId === owner.pluginId &&
      current.generation === owner.generation && current.processEpoch === owner.processEpoch &&
      current.hostEpoch === owner.hostEpoch);
  };
  return this.#stage3Attachment ??= {
    activateInitialized: async (sourceKey, signal) => {
      const supervisor = this.#supervisors.get(sourceKey);
      if (!supervisor) throw new Error("Source has no admitted process");
      const context = await supervisor.activateInitialized(signal);
      if (!channel(context.owner)) throw new Error("Retired initialized owner");
      return context;
    },
    ready: async (owner, signal) => {
      const original = channel(owner);
      if (!original) throw new Error("Retired ready owner");
      const supervisor = this.#supervisors.get(owner.sourceKey);
      if (!supervisor) throw new Error("Missing original supervisor");
      await supervisor.ready(signal);
      if (channel(owner) !== original) throw new Error("Owner changed during ready");
    },
    current: (owner) => channel(owner) !== undefined,
    owners: () => [...this.#stage3Channels.keys()].filter((owner) => channel(owner) !== undefined),
    context: () => null,
    commands: () => Object.freeze([]),
    invoke: async () => { throw new Error("Context commands are unpublished before P160"); },
    dispatchDrain: async () => { throw new Error("Storage drain is unpublished before P170"); },
  };
}
```

`context` cannot confer UI authority at P150. R160 replaces that callback with scope-validated trusted workbench binding and implements commands/invoke using the admitted declarations and original peer. R170 replaces dispatchDrain with the original-peer dispatcher, retained until disposition. Neither later slice changes owner allocation timing or creates a second attachment/ledger. Keep `Stage3RuntimePorts` at exactly three members.

R160's initial-open test additionally queries initial instances before ready; it consumes these R150 barriers rather than changing identity timing.

```ts
import type { PluginSource, PluginManager } from "@kobrixa/plugin-runtime";
import type { BuiltinDeviceProvider, ProviderCatalogPort } from "../device-broker/provider.js";
import type { DeviceBrokerPort } from "../device-broker/broker-port.js";
import { createEv3Provider } from "../device-providers/ev3/provider.js";
import basicPlus from "../../../../../plugins/basic-plus/kobrixa-plugin.json" with { type: "json" };
import tokenizer from "../../../../../plugins/basic-plus/language/tokenizer.json?raw";
import configuration from "../../../../../plugins/basic-plus/language/configuration.json?raw";
import ev3 from "../../../../../plugins/ev3/kobrixa-plugin.json" with { type: "json" };

const capabilities = ["connection.v1", "telemetry.v1", "inputModes.v1", "finiteMotion.v1", "recordingReservation.v1"] as const;
export const BUILTIN_PLUGIN_SOURCES: readonly PluginSource[] = [
  { kind: "builtin", policy: "required", manifest: basicPlus,
    resources: { "language/tokenizer.json": tokenizer, "language/configuration.json": configuration } },
  { kind: "builtin", policy: "required", manifest: ev3, resources: {} },
  { kind: "builtin", policy: "optional", resources: {}, manifest: {
    id: "kobrixa.device-ev3", version: "1.0.0", apiVersion: "^1.5.0", runtime: { kind: "builtin" },
    displayName: { en: "EV3 device provider", "zh-TW": "EV3 設備供應者" },
    contributes: { deviceProviders: [{ id: "kobrixa.device-ev3", capabilities: [...capabilities] }] },
  } },
];

export const BUILTIN_DEVICE_PROVIDER_FACTORIES: Readonly<Record<
  "builtin:kobrixa.device-ev3", (catalog: ProviderCatalogPort) => BuiltinDeviceProvider
>> = Object.freeze({ "builtin:kobrixa.device-ev3": createEv3Provider });

/** The caller owns the broker catalog allocator and the single profile lifetime. */
export function attachBuiltinDeviceProvider(
  manager: Pick<PluginManager, "state" | "onEvent">,
  broker: DeviceBrokerPort,
  catalog: ProviderCatalogPort,
  factory: (catalog: ProviderCatalogPort) => BuiltinDeviceProvider = BUILTIN_DEVICE_PROVIDER_FACTORIES["builtin:kobrixa.device-ev3"],
): () => void {
  let unregister: (() => void) | undefined;
  let initialCatalog: ProviderCatalogPort | undefined = catalog;
  const reconcile = () => {
    const enabled = manager.state().plugins.some((source) => source.sourceKey === "builtin:kobrixa.device-ev3"
      && source.status === "enabled" && !source.required && source.canToggle);
    if (enabled && !unregister) {
      const currentCatalog = initialCatalog ?? broker.providerCatalog("kobrixa.device-ev3");
      initialCatalog = undefined;
      const provider = factory(currentCatalog);
      if (provider.id !== "kobrixa.device-ev3") throw new Error("EV3 allowlist factory returned the wrong provider");
      unregister = broker.registerProvider(provider);
    } else if (!enabled && unregister) {
      const remove = unregister;
      unregister = undefined;
      remove();
    }
  };
  const off = manager.onEvent((event) => { if (event.type === "state") reconcile(); });
  try { reconcile(); } catch (error) { off(); throw error; }
  return () => { off(); const remove = unregister; unregister = undefined; remove?.(); };
}
```

The broker owns provider-generation invalidation and cleanup when its registration disposer runs. No manifest callback or renderer parameter chooses a factory. There is no motor/Lab/device UI payload in this slice. D150 supplies `broker.providerCatalog("kobrixa.device-ev3")` before the first construction. After removal the old allocator is invalid; each subsequent enable/reload obtains a fresh allocator from that same broker. No packaging-local ID map exists.

Replace `apps/desktop/src/renderer/device/battery-status.ts`:

```ts
import type { DeviceMonitorSnapshot } from "@kobrixa/device";
import type { KobrixaApi } from "../../shared/api.js";
export const BATTERY_POLL_MS = 30_000;
export const LOW_BATTERY_PERCENT = 15;
export interface BatteryState {
  sessionId: string | undefined;
  percent: number | null;
  voltage: number | null;
  low: boolean;
}
const empty: BatteryState = { sessionId: undefined, percent: null, voltage: null, low: false };
export class BatteryStatus {
  private state = empty;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private sequence = -1;
  private unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined;
  constructor(api: Pick<KobrixaApi["device"], "onMonitor">) {
    this.unsubscribe = api.onMonitor((update) => {
      if (update.sessionId !== this.state.sessionId || update.sequence <= this.sequence) return;
      this.sequence = update.sequence;
      if (update.status === "live") this.observe(update.sessionId, update.snapshot);
    });
  }
  getSnapshot = (): BatteryState => this.state;
  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener); return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); };
  };
  setSession(sessionId: string | undefined): void {
    if (sessionId === this.state.sessionId) return;
    this.sequence = -1;
    this.publish({ ...empty, sessionId });
  }
  observe(sessionId: string | undefined, snapshot: DeviceMonitorSnapshot | undefined): void {
    if (!snapshot || sessionId !== this.state.sessionId) return;
    const { percent, voltage } = snapshot.battery;
    if (percent === this.state.percent && voltage === this.state.voltage) return;
    this.publish({ ...this.state, percent, voltage, low: percent !== null && percent <= LOW_BATTERY_PERCENT });
  }
  dispose(): void {
    this.unsubscribe?.(); this.unsubscribe = undefined;
    this.setSession(undefined);
  }
  private publish(state: BatteryState): void {
    this.state = state;
    for (const listener of this.listeners) listener();
  }
}
```

```ts
  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    const recovery = this.state.recovery;
    if (recovery) {
      await this.api.device.disconnect(recovery.sessionId);
      if (this.state.recovery?.sessionId === recovery.sessionId)
        this.update({ recovery: undefined, connectionNotice: undefined });
      return;
    }
    const session = this.state.session;
    if (!session || this.state.phase === "disconnecting") return;
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    this.disconnectingSession = session.id;
    this.pendingRun = undefined;
    this.phase("disconnecting");
    try {
      await this.api.device.disconnect(session.id);
      if (generation !== this.generation && this.state.session?.id !== session.id) return;
      if (this.state.session?.id === session.id)
        this.update({ session: undefined, deployed: undefined, connectionNotice: undefined, phase: "idle" });
      this.log("disconnected");
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.state.session?.id === session.id)
        this.update({ phase: "error", error: { phase: "disconnecting", detail: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } });
    } finally {
      if (this.disconnectingSession === session.id) this.disconnectingSession = undefined;
    }
  }
```

```bash
p.write_text(s.replace(before, after))
PY
```

### Complete A negative-matrix obligations

Each row is a concrete assertion obligation for its mapped owner tests; T9 requires non-skipped execution and reviews every listed subcase, not just a matching test title.

#### A §13.1 — required negative/acceptance matrix

| 組別                 | 必備 cases／斷言                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| F01 Registration     | builtin provider 正例；external 欄位為正常陣列／空陣列／null／錯誤型別全拒絕；自稱 builtin／保留 ID／重複 provider／同 physical claimant，交換載入順序結果一致。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F02 Identity         | 相同 pluginId 不同 sourceKey、同 source 新 processEpoch、host restart generation 重用、static retry 不授 execution；每種 handle foreign／stale／unknown 都無設備 call。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F03 Admission        | 五個 capability 各自缺失／版本錯誤、三種 device permissions 的全有／逐一缺失／全無組合、缺 scope／gesture、unbound context、close gate、recording／foreground race。`devices.provide` 永遠無效。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F04 Prepare/start    | prepare 零 I/O；4／5 source refs、16／17 host refs；4,999／5,000／5,001 ms；stop-before-start、重複 start、late start、失敗 start 不可重用、reply 丟失最多一次 dispatch。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| F05 Every boundary   | 在 drain、journal、preflight、每 helper upload chunk、helper run、ready read、arm、每 pulse、每 poll、stop/readback、final journal 前後逐一 revoke；後續 consequential steps 數量為零，必要 stop 保留。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F06 Clocks           | 99／100／101 ms ticks，349／350／351 ms expiry；399／400／401 ms pulse gap；9,999／10,000 ms jog；helper 1,999／2,000 ms arm、10,000 ms watchdog、2,000 ms grace；30 秒 overall 不被 renew 重置。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| F07 Arbitration      | 前景先保留再 drain，無 USB abort 搶鎖；monitor／battery／Lab 共用一個 poll；mode write／recording／motion matrix；stop 使用原 ownership，無自鎖／telemetry starvation。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F08 Stop             | normal coast、forced brake escalation、stop reply lost、busy settle 最多五次、全輸出 unknown／非零 speed、helper token mismatch、readback 15 秒，無確認不報 stopped/completed。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| F09 Provider faults  | throw-before-send、throw-after-send、invalid DTO、late resolve、Promise 永不 settle、斷線於各 exchange；保留 dispatch unknown、session quarantine，不能只 race timeout 就借出 lock。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| F10 Journal          | 首次 pending write／sync／rename／directory sync 每一步 crash；final commit 同樣注入；disk-full、short write、corrupt current／previous／temp、unknown schema、65th unresolved entry、8 MiB replacement reservation、single-instance gate 先於所有 writers；已發送必有 durable marker。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F11 Recovery         | restart pending→unconfirmed；同 serial idle 只 resolve current quarantine、先前 movement unknown；同 IP 不同 brick／缺 serial／重複 serial 不自動解除；所有 optional disabled 時 core ledger 可讀；core action expired／consumed／錯 scope／target 拒絕，不接受裸 token／feature actionRef／invocationId。                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| F12 Recording        | 2,499／2,500／2,501 ms fresh；4／5 channels；reserve 期間 source 變更；pin 排斥 mode；foreground busy／gap；ring overflow range；release=`released`、suspend=`suspended`、Disconnect=`core-disconnect`、provider/session loss=`disconnected`；first end reason／10 秒 grant 固定；retire 不續期；30 分鐘／3,600 frames，無自動恢復。                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| F13 Events           | snapshot／subscribe race、duplicate／out-of-order／skipped sequence、ack 未發送 sequence、32／33 subscriptions、8 control slots、10 秒 ack timeout、64 frames／64 KiB／256 KiB 邊界、unsubscribe 首次 true／同 owner tombstone false／foreign stale、callback hang；control／telemetry 均 validation＋bounded enqueue 後 ack；1.5→1.6→1.7 kind registry、未知 kind 拒絕、sequence-only gap，不新增 wire alias。                                                                                                                          |
| F14 Legacy writes    | upload/deploy 每 chunk revoke，run no-reply，rename copy→verify→remove 中途失權，batch 每 entry／file-close；偽造 download plan 不放行，read/download/stop 失權後仍可用。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| F15 File leases      | 119,999／120,000 ms；明確 renew 到 599,999／600,000 ms；hidden timer 不續租；掃描／dialog／execute 都計 hardDeadline；過期 native dialog 不復活；保留 partial。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| F16 SDK parity       | 同 fixtures 在 Zod／generated schema＋semantic validators／JS／Python；實際 MessagePort 與 Content-Length 分段／合併 stdio，5／15／65 秒 wait、cancel、late reply、business false、structured detail 與 terminal events 一致。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| F17 Lifecycle        | umbrella §4.7 每列及 §4.5 Disconnect 規則：motor hide stop、Lab hide continue、disable、provider disable、renderer crash、plugin crash、shutdown、safe mode、一次 Disconnect 的停／存／斷線、suspend 停存與 wake 不續作、second launch；24 秒 cleanup／25 秒 outer net；舊 callbacks 不重建資源。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| F18 Shared contracts | permission／user-action-required、resource stale／quota／rate／queue 的 code-kind-reason 正反例；按批次 resource enum、跨 domain revision 不比較；1.6／1.7／1.8 host 的 devicesContractVersion 仍為 1。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F19 Sibling ports    | ReservationBindingPort 同 owner／generation／session；end-before／during／after durable registration、duplicate end／retire 合併且不續期；正常 release、Disconnect、suspend、provider loss 的 endReservation／drain 不 retire 健康 consumer。DeviceSessionControlPort 封鎖新工作、先 stop/save 後 disconnect；驗 suspended／core-disconnect、action claim／continuation／foreign session、save failure blocker、wake 不續作。renderer loss drain 後 process teardown 與新 bindings；retire().drain 原樣傳 freeze 第四參數，null 時省略。 |
| F20 Startup policy   | app single-instance lock false 分支不建立 journal／persistence／provider／worker；second launch 還原聚焦既有視窗，不重建或結束錄製；primary journal／persistence 共用同一 port，cleanup 未完不釋放。optional 預設啟用／一般使用者 toggle／safe mode 保持同一 policy。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F21 Exchange budgets | motor 2 秒／其他普通 5 秒／file-transfer 10 秒邊界與 remaining budget；helper upload 已送後撤權不發下一 chunk，15 秒 stop 包含最多 10 秒 in-flight，確認不足即 unconfirmed，總關閉 budget 不延長。                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
